आ: आ 1. आ, the second letter of the alphabet, corresponding to अ long, as in far.

आ 2. आ, (as a particle or interjection of as-sent) yes, verily; (of compassion or pain) Ah! Alas! in the latter sense it is more correctly written आस्; (of reminiscence) Ah! Oh! (a conjunction dis-junctive) but; (a conjunction copulative) and. This particle remains unaltered in orthography even before vowels.

आ 3. आ a prefix to verbs and nouns, (ex-pressing) near, near to, towards, from all sides, all around; and sometimes redundant. As a prefix to verbs of motion it expresses the notion of moving or going towards; e. g. आ-क्रामति, he goes towards. When prefixed to roots like गम्, या, and इ, to go, and दा, to give, it reverses the action; e. g. आ-गच्छति, he comes; आ-दत्ते, he takes. As unconnected with verbs and prefixed to nouns it forms with them either compound adverbs or adjectives, implying the limit conclusive (until, unto, as far as), or the limit inceptive (from, from thence or that time); e. g. आ-मरणम्, till death; आ-कुमारम्, from childhood [cf. a puero]; आ-गोपाला द्विजातयः, the twice-born including the cowherds. (Prefixed to adjectives &c. it implies) diminution; e. g. आ-पाण्डु, a little pale; आ-पक्व, half-cooked. (As a separable adverb आ implies) near, near to, towards; thereto, further, also, and; especially, even. In many places in the Vedas आ gives force to the word which precedes it (e. g. महिमा वाम् इन्-द्राग्नी पनिष्ठ आ, ‘your greatness, O Indra and Agni, is praiseworthy indeed’); and in a similar man-ner we find it in the Veda placed after prepositions, the sense of which is strengthened by it. (As a separable preposition with acc. or abl.) near to, up to, to, as far as; e. g. शतम् आ जातीस्, as far as a hundred births; आ समुद्रात्, as far as the ocean: (with abl.) away from, from; out of, of, from among; e. g. आ मूलात्, from the beginning; बहुभ्य आ, from among many: (with loc.) in, at; e. g. दम आ, in a house.
आ 4. आ, आस्, m., N. of Śiva; (आ), f., N. of Lakṣmī.

आगस्तीय: आगस्तीय, अस्, आ, अम्, relating to or tending to the advantage of Agasti.
आगा: आगा 1. आ-गा, cl. 2. P. -गाति, -तुम्, to come towards or into; to approach, make one's appearance; to meet with; to visit.
2. आ-गा, आस्, आस्, अम्, coming towards, &c.
आगार: आगार आ-गार, अम्, n. (probably fr. आ-गॄ, ‘to swallow down,’ and denoting first any inner re-ceptacle), room, covered place, dwelling, house, recep-tacle [cf. अ-गार]. —आगार-गोधिका, f. a lizard (?). —आगार-दाह, अस्, m. arson, setting a house on fire. —आगार-दाहिन्, ई, m. an incendiary. —आगार-धूम, अस्, m., N. of a plant.
आगुर्: आगुर् 1. आ-गुर्, cl. 6. A. -गुरते, -रितुम् (गुर् = rt. गॄ, see आ-गॄ), to approve, to agree or assent to, to promise, to pronounce the Āgur.
2. आ-गुर्, ऊर्, f., Ved., N. of a class of plauditory or approving exclamations or formularies used by the priests in sacrificial rites; assent, an agreement.
आगुरण: आ-गुरण or आ-गूरण or आ-गूर्ण, अम्, n. recita-tion of the Āgur.
आगूर्तिन्: आ-गूर्तिन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. performing or pronounc-ing the Āgur.
आगुरव: आगुरव आगुरव, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अ-गुरु), originating from or formed of Agallochum. See अ-गुरु।
आगृ: आगृ आ-गॄ, cl. 9. P. A., Ved. -गृणाति, -णीते, -गरितुम् or -रीतुम्, to approve, to praise.
आगै: आगै आ-गै, cl. 1. P., Ved. -गायति, -गातुम्, to sing to, to obtain by singing.
आगातृ: आ-गातृ, ता, त्री, तृ, obtaining by singing.
आगान: आ-गान, अम्, n. the act of obtaining by song.
आग्नापौष्ण: आग्नापौष्ण आग्नापौष्ण, अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. belonging or referring to Agni and Pūṣan.
आग्नावैष्णव: आग्नावैष्णव, अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. belonging or referring to Agni and Viṣṇu.
आग्निक: आग्निक आग्निक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अग्नि), fiery, belonging to fire or to a sacrifice performed with fire.
आग्निमारुत: आग्निमारुत, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging or referring to Agni and the Maruts; (अस्), m. an epithet of Agastya; (अम्), n. a hymn praising Agni and the Maruts [cf. Pāṇini VII. 3, 21; VI. 3, 28].
आग्निवारुण: आग्निवारुण, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging or referring to Agni and Varuṇa.
आग्निवेश्य: आग्निवेश्य and आग्निवेश्यायन, अस्, m., N. of two teachers.
आग्निष्टोमिक: आग्निष्टोमिक, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging to the Ag-niṣṭoma; one who recites or is conversant with the Agniṣṭoma.
आग्निहोत्र: आग्निहोत्र, अस्, ई, अम्, fit for the Agnihotra.
आग्नीध्र: आग्नीध्र, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. originating from or belonging to the Agnīdh, i. e. to the priest who kindles the fire; (अस्), m. the priest who kindles the fire; (आ), f. care of the sacred fire; (अम्), n. the place where a sacrificial fire is kindled; the function of the priest who kindles the sacred fire.
आग्नीध्रीय: आग्नीध्रीय, अस्, आ, अम्, being within the Āgnī-dhra or the place where a sacrificial fire is kindled; (अस्), m. the fire (अग्नि) within the Āgnīdhra; the fire-place (धिष्ण्य) within the Āgnīdhra.
आग्नीध्र्य: आग्नीध्र्य, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging to the Āgnīdhra or the priest who kindles the sacred fire.
आग्नेन्द्र: आग्नेन्द्र, अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. consecrated to Agni and Indra.
आग्नेय: आग्नेय, अस्, ई, अम्, fiery, belonging or relating or consecrated to fire or its deity Agni; similar to fire or Agni; belonging to Agnāyī, wife of Agni; (अस्), m. epithet of Skanda; of Agastya; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a people; (ई), f., N. of Agnāyī, wife of Agni; the wife of Ūru and daughter of Agni (?); the south-east quarter, of which Agni is the regent; (अम्), n. blood; ghee or boiled butter; gold; N. of a region. —आग्नेय-कीट, अस्, m. an insect (कीट) which flies into the fire (applied to a thief who breaks into a room and extinguishes the lamp). —आग्नेय-पुराण, अम्, n. the same as the अग्नि-पुराण, q. v.
आग्न्याधेयिक: आग्न्याधेयिक, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging to the Agny-ādheya. See under अग्नि।
आग्रन्थ्: आग्रन्थ् आ-ग्रन्थ्, cl. 9. 1. P. -ग्रथ्नाति, -ग्रन्थति, -थितुम्, to wind round, to intwine.
आग्रभोजनिक: आग्रभोजनिक आग्रभोजनिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अग्र-भोजन), one to whom food is first offered.
आग्रयण: आग्रयण आग्रयण, अस्, m. (fr. अग्र), the first Soma libation at the Agniṣṭoma sacrifice (see ग्रह); a form of Agni; (ई), f. an oblation consisting of first-fruits or firstling; (अम्), n. oblation consisting of first-fruits at the end of the rainy season.
आग्रस्त: आग्रस्त आ-ग्रस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, bored, per-forated.
आग्रह्: आग्रह् आ-ग्रह्, Ved. -ग्रभ्, cl. 9. P. A. -गृह्णाति, -णीते, Ved. -गृभ्णाति, -णीते, -ग्रही-तुम्, to seize, take hold of; to draw tight (as reins).
आग्रह: आ-ग्रह, अस्, m. seizing, taking; attack; surpass-ing, surmounting; favour; patronage; power, ability; moral power, courage.
आग्रहयण: आग्रहयण आग्रहयण, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging to the month Agra-hayaṇa (= अग्र-हायण, q. v.).
आग्रहायण: आग्रहायण, अस्, m. ‘commencement of the year,’ N. of a Hindū month commencing about the 12th of November, see अग्र-हायण; (ई), f. the day of full moon (पौर्णमासी) in the month Agra-hāyaṇa; a particular kind of Pāka-yajña, q. v.; N. of a con-stellation consisting of three stars, one of which is λ Orionis, figured by an antelope's head, hence also called Mṛga-śiras.
आग्रहायणक: आग्रहायणक, अस्, ई, अम्, to be paid (as a debt &c.) on the day of full moon in the month Agra-hāyaṇa.
आग्रहायणिक: आग्रहायणिक, अस्, m. the month Agra-hāyaṇa; (अस्, ई, अम्), to be paid on the day of full moon in the month Agra-hāyaṇa.
आग्रहारिक: आग्रहारिक आग्रहारिक, अस्, ई, अम्, one who appropriates to himself an Agra-hāra, viz. an endow-ment of lands or villages conferred upon Brāhmans.
आग्रायण: आग्रायण आग्रायण, अस्, m., N. of a gram-marian; a sacrifice offered when the new rice or wheat ripens; (see आग्रयण, which is the correct reading.) —आग्रायणेष्टि (°ण-इष्°), इस्, f. the ceremony Āgrāyaṇa.
आघट्टक: आघट्टक आ-घट्टक, अस्, m. (rt. घट्ट् or घट्), a rubber; anything which causes friction; the plant Desmochæta Atropurpurea.
आघट्टन: आ-घट्टन, अम्, n. friction, rubbing, contact, shaking.
आघाट: आ-घाट, अस्, m., Ved. a musical instrument used for accompanying a dance; a cymbal or rattle; boun-dary, limit; the plant Achyranthes Aspera; (at the end of some compounds) = आ-घात, see next col.
आघाटि: आ-घाटि, इस्, इस्, m. f, Ved. a musical instrument which sounds on being shaken, a cymbal or rattle.
आघर्ष: आघर्ष आ-घर्ष, अस्, m. (rt. घृष्), rubbing, friction.
आघर्षण: आ-घर्षण, अस्, ई, अम्, scratching, rubbing; (अम्), n. rubbing, friction; (ई), f. a brush, a rubber.
आघर्षित: आ-घर्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, rubbed, brushed.
आघात: आघात आ-घात, अस्, m. (fr. rt. हन् with आ), striking, a blow, a wound; killing; a beater, striker; retention of urine; misfortune, pain; a slaughter-house, a place for killing animals or victims.
आघातन: आ-घातन, अम्, n. striking, killing; a slaughter-house.
आघ्नत्: आ-घ्नत्, अन्, अती, अत्, striking, beating.
आघार: आ-घार, अस्, m. sprinkling, sprinkling clarified butter upon the fire at certain sacrifices; ghee or clarified butter.
आघुष्: आघुष् आ-घुष्, cl. 1. P. -घोषति, -घो-षितुम्, to make one's self audible; to cry aloud, to proclaim; to praise; to listen to: Caus. -घोषयति, -यितुम्, to make a noise, to cause to sound; to pro-claim or cause to proclaim aloud; to complain con-tinually.
आघोष: आ-घोष, अस्, m. calling out to, invocation.
आघोषण: आ-घोषण, अम्, आ, n. f. a crying or proclaiming, public announcement.
आघूर्ण्: आघूर्ण् आ-घूर्ण्, cl. 6. P., 1. A. -घूर्णति, -घूर्णते, -णितुम्, to fluctuate, stagger; to roll, whirl.
आघूर्णन: आ-घूर्णन, अम्, n. rolling, tossing; fluctuating, whirling round.
आघूर्णित: आ-घूर्णित, अस्, आ, अम्, rolled, rolling; whirled round, fluctuating.
आघृ: आघृ आ-घृ, cl. 1., and Ved. cl. 3. P. -घरति, -जिघर्ति, -घर्तुम्, to sprinkle towards or upon: Caus. -घारयति, -यितुम्, to sprinkle.
आघृणि: आघृणि आ-घृणि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. glowing with heat; endowed with splendor; epithet of the god Pūṣan. —आघृणी-वसु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. rich with heat, epithet of Agni; (Sāy.) having splendid wealth.
आघ्रा: आघ्रा आ-घ्रा, cl. 1. P. -जिघ्रति, -घ्रातुम्, to smell, smell at; to kiss: Caus. -घ्रापयति, -यि-तुम्, to cause to smell at.
आघ्राण: आ-घ्राण, अम्, n. smelling; satisfaction, satiety; (अस्, आ, अम्), satisfied, satiated.
आघ्रात: आ-घ्रात, अस्, आ, अम्, smelled, scented; satisfied, satiated; surmounted, surpassed.
आघ्रेय: आ-घ्रेय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be smelled at.
आङ्कुशायन: आङ्कुशायन आङ्कुशायन, adj. formed fr. अङ्कुश। See Gaṇa to Pāṇini IV. 2, 80.
आङ्कृति: आङ्कृति आङ्कृति, इस्, m., N. of a prince.
आङ्क्षी: आङ्क्षी आङ्क्षी, f. a musical instrument, a tabor.
आङ्ग: आङ्ग आङ्ग, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. 2. अङ्ग), re-lating to the base (अङ्ग), of a word in grammar; bodily, corporeal; having limbs or parts or relating to them; relating to the inferior persons of a drama, to a portion of the Vedas, &c.; (अम्), n. a soft deli-cate form or body; (अस्, ई, अम्, pl. ăङ्गास्), produced or born in the country Aṅga; a prince of that country.
आङ्गक: आङ्गक, अस्, m. the ruler of the country Aṅga; an inhabitant of the same.
आङ्गविद्य: आङ्गविद्य, अस्, ई, अम्, occurring in or being fami-liar with chiromancy or the knowledge of lucky and unlucky marks on the body. See अङ्ग-विद्या।
आङ्गिक: आङ्गिक, अस्, ई, अम्, bodily, corporeal; gesticulated, expressed by bodily action (dramatic sentiment, pas-sion &c., exhibited by attitude, gesture &c.); (अस्), m. a player on a tabor or drum.
आङ्गदी: आङ्गदी आङ्गदी, f., N. of the capital of Aṅgada's kingdom.
आङ्गार: आङ्गार आङ्गार, अम्, n. (fr. अङ्गार), a mul-titude of firebrands.
आङ्गिरस: आङ्गिरस आङ्गिरस, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अङ्गिरस्), descended from or belonging to or referring to the Aṅgirasas or to Aṅgiras; (अस्), m. a descendant of Aṅgiras; especially a N. of Vṛhaspati, the preceptor of the gods; a Kṣatriya by will of Brahmā and by profession.
आङ्गुलिक: आङ्गुलिक आङ्गुलिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अङ्गुलि, q. v.), like a finger.
आङ्गूष: आङ्गूष आङ्गूष, अस्, m., Ved. praising aloud, a hymn [cf. अङ्गूष, अङ्गोषिन्].
आङ्गूष्य: आङ्गूष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. praising aloud, sound-ing; fit for praise.
आङ्गेयी: आङ्गेयी आङ्गेयी probably = आङ्गी। See आङ्ग।
आङ्ग्य: आङ्ग्य, adj. fr. अङ्ग, q. v.
आच: आच 1. आच, अस्, m., N. of a man.
आच 2. आच, in the words आच-पराच and आचोपच, ‘turned towards and away from’ (?).
आचक्ष्: आचक्ष् आ-चक्ष्, cl. 2. A. -चष्टे, -ष्टुम्, to look at, inspect; to tell, relate, make a communication about anything (with acc.); to announce, declare; to make known, confess; to acquaint, introduce to; to address any one (with acc.); to call, name.
आचक्षमाण: आ-चक्षमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, saying, declaring.
आचक्षुस्: आ-चक्षुस्, उस्, m. a learned man, a Paṇḍit.
आचतुरम्: आचतुरम् आ-चतुरम्, ind. till the fourth generation.
आचतुर्य: आचतुर्य आचतुर्य, अम्, n. (fr. अ-चतुर), clumsiness, stupidity.
आचम्: आचम् आ-चम्, cl. 1. P. -चामति, -चमितुम्, to sip; to rinse the mouth (with inst. of the thing); to lap up, lick up, to cause to disappear (as the wind licks up moisture): Caus. -चामयति, -यितुम्, to cause to sip water.
आचम: आ-चम, अस्, m. rinsing the mouth.
आचमन: आ-चमन, अम्, n. rinsing the mouth, sipping water (before religious ceremonies, before meals &c., from the palm of the hand. It is usual to spit the water out again; the ceremony also includes touching the body in various parts); gargling the throat; the water used for rinsing the mouth.
आचमनक: आ-चमनक, अस्, m. a spitting pot.
आचमनीय: आचमनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, used for rinsing the mouth; (अम्), n. water for rinsing the mouth, a gargle.
आचम्य: आ-चम्य, ind. having rinsed the mouth, having sipped and ejected a little water.
आचान्त: आ-चान्त, अस्, आ, अम्, sipped and ejected (as water); one who has rinsed his mouth.
आचाम: आ-चाम, अस्, m. sipping water, rinsing the mouth; the water or foam of boiled rice.
आचामक: आ-चामक, अस्, आ, अम्, rinsing the mouth.
आचामनक: आ-चामनक, अस्, m. a spitting pot.
आचाम्य: आ-चाम्य, अम्, n. rinsing the mouth, water so used, a gargle; (अस्, आ, अम्), to be rinsed.
आचय: आचय आ-चय, अस्, m. (fr. rt. चि with आ), collection, plenty.
आचयक: आचयक, अस्, आ, अम्, collecting, skilful in col-lecting.
आचर्: आचर् आ-चर्, cl. 1. P. ep. A. -चरति, -ते, -रितुम्, Ved. -रध्यै, -रितवे, -रसे, to come near to, approach; to step upon, pass through; to pro-ceed, manage, behave one's self towards (with loc.); to treat; to have intercourse with, frequent; to act, undertake, do, exercise, practice, perform; to devour, eat into; to help forward, put into.
आचरण: आ-चरण, अम्, n. approaching, arrival; following, observing, conduct, usage, practice; an institute, rite or rule of conduct; a cart, carriage.
आचरणीय: आ-चरणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be done or performed; to be followed or observed, right, proper.
आचरत्: आ-चरत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, following, practising, ob-serving.
आचरित: आ-चरित, अस्, आ, अम्, observed, practised, as a rite or usage; usual, customary; enjoined, fixed by rule.
आचरितव्य: आ-चरितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be performed in a customary manner; to be done or performed.
आचर्य: आ-चर्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be gone to or approached; to be done or performed.
आचार: आ-चार, अस्, m. conduct, manner of action; beha-viour; good conduct, good behaviour; custom, prac-tice, usage; an established rule of conduct, an ordi-nance, an institute, a precept; manner of conducting one's self, diet; rule; [cf. Hib. acara, ‘convenience, conveniency, use.’] —आचार-चन्द्रिका, f. title of a work on the religious customs of the Śūdras. —आचार-तन्त्र, अम्, n. one of the four classes of Tantras with Buddhists. —आचार-दीप, अस्, m. ‘lamp of re-ligious customs,’ title of a work. —आचार-भ्रष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, fallen from established usage, apostate. —आचार-मयूख, अस्, m. ‘ray of religious cus-toms,’ title of a work. —आचार-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, well-conducted, virtuous. —आचार-वरिजित, अस्, आ, अम्, irregular, out of rule; outcast. —आचार-विरुद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, contrary to custom. —आचार-वेदी, f. ‘altar of religious customs,’ a N. of Āryāvarta. —आ-चार-हीन, अस्, आ, अम्, deprived of established ordi-nances, outcast. —आचाराङ्ग (°र-अङ्°), अम्, n. title of the first of the twelve sacred books of the Jainas. —आचारादर्श (°र-आद्°), अस्, m. ‘looking-glass of religious customs,’ title of a work. —आचारार्क (°र-अर्°), अस्, m. ‘sun of religious customs,’ title of a work. —आचारोल्लास (°र-उल्ल्°), अस्, m. ‘light of religious customs,’ title of a work.
आचारिक: आचारिक, अस्, ई, अम्, conformable to rule or prac-tice, prescriptive, authorized; (अम्), n. rules for the preservation of health, habit of life, regimen, diet.
आचारिन्: आचारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, following established rites or practice.
आचारी: आ-चारी, f. the plant Hingtsha Repens, also called Hilamocikā.
आचार्य: आ-चार्य, अस्, m. lit. ‘one to whom one must have recourse’ or ‘one who is to be attended to or waited on’ or ‘one whose precepts are to be followed’ or ‘one who knows the आचार or rules;’ a spiritual guide or teacher, especially one who invests the student with the sacrificial thread, and instructs him in the Vedas, in the law of sacrifice and religious mysteries (Manu 2. 140, 171); an epithet of Droṇa the teacher of the Pāṇḍus; (आ), f. a spiritual preceptress. The title आचार्य affixed to names of learned men is rather like our Dr.; e. g. राघवाचार्य, &c. —आचार्य-करण, अम्, n. acting as teacher. —आ-चार्य-ता, f. or आचार्य-त्व, अम्, n. the office or pro-ficiency of a holy teacher. —आचार्य-देव, अस्, m. one whose preceptor is his god. —आचार्य-भो-गीन, अस्, आ, अम्, delighting the holy teacher. —आचार्य-मिश्र, अस्, आ, अम्, venerable, honourable. —आचार्य-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, one who has a teacher. —आचार्योपासन (°य-उप्°), अम्, n. waiting upon or serving the spiritual preceptor.
आचार्यक: आचार्यक, अस्, आ, अम्, originating from a spiritual teacher; (अम्), n. the proficiency of a holy teacher.
आचार्यानी: आचार्यानी, f. (with dental न्, Pāṇini IV. 1, 49. Vārt. 6), the wife of an Ācārya or holy teacher.
आचीर्ण: आ-चीर्ण, अस्, आ, अम् (anom. past pass. part.), de-voured, eaten into.
आचीर्ण आ-चीर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्। See under आ-चर् last col.
आचरण्य: आचरण्य आ-चरण्य (nom. fr. चरण), P. -चरण्यति, -यितुम्, to move one's self, to move or extend towards.
आचल्: आचल् आ-चल्, Caus. P. -चालयति, -यितुम्, to move, draw away from one's place, stir up.
आचि: आचि आ-चि, cl. 5. P. A. -चिनोति, -नुते, -चेतुम्, to accumulate; to collect; to heap up, load with; to cover.
आचित: आ-चित, अस्, आ, अम्, collected, accumulated, heaped; filled, loaded with, covered; spread, diffused; inlaid, set (e. g. अर्धाचिता रसना, a girdle half set with gems); larded; (अस्, अम्), m. n. a cart-load; a mea-sure of ten bhāras or cart-loads.
आचितिक: आचितिक, अस्, ई, अम्, or आचितीन, अस्, आ, अम्, holding or being equal to or cooking a quantity equal to the preceding measure; (a numeral may be placed be-fore these forms, e. g. द्व्याचितिक, &c.).
आचिख्यासा: आचिख्यासा आ-चिख्यासा, f. (fr. Desid. of rt. ख्या with आ), desire or intention of expressing or denoting something.
आचित्: आचित् 1. आ-चित्, cl. 1. 3. P. -चेतति, -चिकेत्ति, A. -चिकिते, -चेत्तुम्, to attend to, to keep in mind; to comprehend, understand, know; to invent; to ap-pear, become visible, distinguish one's self: Desid. -चिकित्सति, -ते, to wait for, watch clandestinely, lurk.
2. आ-चित्, त्, f., Ved. taking notice or cognizance, attention to; (according to Sāy. the form आ-चिता may stand for आ-चिते fr. आ-चित above.)
आचूषण: आचूषण आ-चूषण, अम्, n. suction; suck-ing out; application of cupping-glasses to the skin.
आचृत्: आचृत् आ-चृत्, cl. 6. P. -चृतति, -चर्तितुम्, to fasten, tie, affix.
आचेश्वर: आचेश्वर आचेश्वर (°च-ईश्°), अस्, m., N. of a sanctuary built by Āca.
आचेष्ट्: आचेष्ट् आ-चेष्ट्, cl. 1. P. A. -चेष्टति, -ते, -टितुम्, to undertake; to do.
आच्छद्: आच्छद् 1. आ-च्छद् (-छद्), cl. 10. P. -च्छ-दयति or -च्छादयति, -यितुम्, to cover, hide; to clothe, to dress, put on clothes; to conceal.
2. आ-च्छद्, त्, f., Ved. a cover, covering; a sheath. —आच्छद्-विधान, अम्, n., Ved. an arrangement made for defence, a means of covering; or (अस्, आ, अम्), one who has such means.
आच्छन्न: आ-च्छन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, covered, concealed, clothed.
आच्छादक: आ-च्छादक, अस्, आ, अम्, concealing, hiding.
आच्छादन: आ-च्छादन, अम्, n. covering, concealing, hiding; disappearance; a covering, a sheath; cloth, clothes; mantle, cloak, &c.; the wooden frame of a roof.
आच्छादित: आ-च्छादित, अस्, आ, अम्, covered, clothed.
आच्छादिन्: आ-च्छादिन्, ई, इनी, इ, covering, concealing.
आच्छाद्य: 1. आ-च्छाद्य, ind. having clothed or put on.
2. आ-च्छाद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be covered or clothed.
आच्छाक: आच्छाक आच्छाक, अस्, m., N. of the tree Morinda Tinctoria; (better आच्छुक, q. v.)
आच्छिद्: आच्छिद् आ-च्छिद् (-छिद्), cl. 7. P. A. -च्छि-नत्ति, -च्छिन्ते, -च्छेत्तुम्, to tear or cut off; to cut or break in pieces; to take out of; to draw off; remove; to cut off, exclude; to snatch away, to tear from, to rob; to disregard, not to take notice of.
आच्छिद्य: आ-च्छिद्य, ind. cutting off; cutting, excluding, dis-regarding; setting aside, in spite of, notwithstanding.
आच्छिन्न: आ-च्छिन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, cut, cut off.
आच्छेद: आ-च्छेद, अस्, m. cutting, cutting off, excision.
आच्छेदन: आ-च्छेदन, अम्, n. excision, cutting off, exclusion.
आच्छुक: आच्छुक आच्छुक, अस्, m., N. of the plant Morinda Tinctoria. See आक्षिक and आच्छाक।
आच्छुरित: आच्छुरित आ-च्छुरित, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. छुर् with आ), scratched; irritated; (अम्), n. making a noise with the finger-nails by rubbing them on one another; a horse-laugh.
आच्छुरितक: आच्छुरितक, अम्, n. a scratch with a finger-nail; a horse-laugh.
आच्छृद्: आच्छृद् आ-च्छृद् (-छृद्), cl. 7. P. A. -च्छृ-णत्ति, -च्छृन्ते, -च्छर्दितुम्, to pour upon, to fill.
आच्छो: आच्छो आ-च्छो (-छो), cl. 4. P. -च्छ्यति, -च्छातुम्, to skin, to flay.
आच्छोदन: आच्छोदन आ-च्छोदन, अम्, n. (rt. छुद् for चुद् ?), hunting, the chase. See अच्छोटन, आक्षोदन।
आच्यु: आच्यु आ-च्यु, Caus. P. A. -च्यावयति, -ते, -यितुम्, to cause to flow over, pour out; to draw or bring near; to induce (any one) to come near.
आच्युतदन्ति: आच्युतदन्ति आच्युतदन्ति (fr. अच्युतदन्त) or आच्युतन्ति (fr. अच्युतन्त), अयस्, m. pl., N. of a warrior-tribe.
आज्: आज् आज् (आ-अज्), cl. 1. P. A. आजति, -ते, -जितुम्, to drive or bring towards; to procure; to drive near, i. e. to come near in a carriage.
आजनि: आजनि, इस्, f., Ved. a stick for driving.
आजि: 1. आजि, इस्, m. f. (Ved. m.), a running-match; (आजिम् अज् or इ or धाव् or सृ, to run with or against any one for the prize); a fighting-match, fighting, combat, battle, war; place for running, course, level ground; abuse, invective; an instant; [cf. Scot. àgh, ‘fight;’ Hib. agh.] —आजि-कृत्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. running or fight-ing for a prize; making war. —आजि-क्रिया, f. fighting, making war. —आजि-तुर्, ऊर्, ऊर्, ऊर्, Ved. victorious in battles. —आजि-पति, इस्, m., Ved. lord of the battle. —आज्य्-अन्त, अस्, m. the goal in a race-course.
आजि 1. आजि। See under आज् above.
आजि 2. आ-जि, cl. 1. P. -जयति, -जेतुम्, to conquer, win, acquire: Desid. -जिगीषति, to try or desire to conquer or win.
आज: आज आज, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. 1. अज), coming from goats, belonging to goats, produced by goats; (अस्), m. a vulture; (अम्), n. boiled or clarified butter; ghee.
आजक: आजक, अम्, n. a flock of goats.
आजकार: आजकार आजकार, अस्, m. Śiva's bull.
आजगर: आजगर आजगर, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अज-गर), treating of the boa or large serpent; (a chapter in the Mahā-bhārata.)
आजगव: आजगव आजगव, अस्, m. the bow of Śiva [cf. अजकाव].
आजन्: आजन् आ-जन्, cl. 4. A., Ved. -जायते, -जनि-तुम्, to be born or come into existence, to be pro-duced or born from; to beget, cause to be born, render prolific.
आजन्म: आ-जन्म, ind. from birth, since birth. —आजन्म-सुरभि-पत्त्र, अस्, m., N. of a plant (the leaves of which are fragrant from their first appearance).
आजान: आ-जान, अम्, n. birth, descent, species; birth-place.
आजान आ-जान, आजानेय। See under आजन्।
आजानि: आ-जानि, इस्, f., Ved. birth, descent; noble birth; (Sāy.) a mother.
आजानेय: आजानेय, अस्, ई, अम्, of noble origin, of good breed (as a horse), fearless, undaunted; (अस्), m. a well-bred horse.
आजानेय्य: आजानेय्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. of good breed, well-bred.
आजप्: आजप् आ-जप्, cl. 1. P. -जपति, -पितुम्, to mutter or whisper to.
आजमीढ: आजमीढ आजमीढ, अस्, m., N. of a king in the Mahā-bhārata.
आजरसम्: आजरसम् आ-जरसम् or आ-जरसाय, ind., Ved. till old age.
आजवन: आजवन आ-जवन, अम्, n. (fr. rt. जु with आ), rushing at, attacking, fighting.
आजवस्तेय: आजवस्तेय आजवस्तेय (patronymic fr. अज-वस्ति Pāṇini IV. 1, 136).
आजवाह: आजवाह आजवाह or आजवाहक fr. अज-वाह Pāṇini IV. 2, 133.
आजातशत्रव: आजातशत्रव आजातशत्रव, अस्, m. (fr. अजा-त-शत्रु), epithet of Bhadrasena in the Śatapatha-Brāhmaṇa V. 5. 5, 14.
आजाद्य: आजाद्य आजाद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, originating from the warrior-tribe called Ajādas or a chief of that tribe.
आजिगीषु: आ-जिगीषु, उस्, उस्, उ, ambitious, wishing to excel or overcome.
आजिग्रह: आजिग्रह आ-जिग्रह, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. ग्रह्), who or what takes or seizes.
आजिज्ञासेन्य: आजिज्ञासेन्य आ-जिज्ञासेन्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. Desid. of rt. ज्ञा with आ), Ved. liable to investigation; (आस्), f. pl., N. of a short section of the Kuntāpa hymns in the Aitareya-Brāhmaṇa; (the word ऋचस् must be supplied.)
आजिहीर्षु: आजिहीर्षु आ-जिहीर्षु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. Desid. of rt. हृ with आ), about to bring towards (with acc.); wishing to take.
आजीकूल: आजीकूल आजीकूल, N. of a region.
आजीगर्ति: आजीगर्ति आजीगर्ति, a patronymic fr. अजी-गर्त।
आजीव्: आजीव् आ-जीव्, cl. 1. P. -जीवति, -वितुम्, to live by; to have the use or enjoyment of; to subsist.
आजीव: आ-जीव, अस्, m. livelihood, subsistence; a Jaina beggar.
आजीवक: आ-जीवक, अस्, m. a beggar, one who obtains his livelihood everywhere.
आजीवन: आ-जीवन, अम्, n. livelihood, subsistence. —आजीव-नार्थ (°न-अर्°), अस्, m. (अम्, n. ?) means of live-lihood or subsistence, business, profession.
आजीविन्: आ-जीविन्, ई, m. having a livelihood; a peculiar kind of beggar.
आजीव्य: आ-जीव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be practised as a means of living; fit for or affording a livelihood; habitable, fertile; fruitful; (अम्), n. means of living.
आजुर्: आजुर् आ-जुर्, ऊर्, f. or आ-जू, ऊस्, f. (fr. rt. जॄ with आ ?), unpaid labour, working without wages; consigning to hell; infirm age (?).
आज्ञा: आज्ञा 1. आ-ज्ञा, cl. 9. P. -जानाति, -ज्ञातुम्, to know, understand, learn, obtain information, ascer-tain, notice, perceive: Caus. -ज्ञापयति, -यितुम्, to publish, order, command, direct; to assure.

2. आ-ज्ञा, f. an order, a command; allowance, per-mission; [cf. Hib. agna, ‘wisdom.’] —आज्ञा-कर, अस्, ई, अम्, executing an order, obeying, obedient; (अस्), m. a servant. —आज्ञा-करण, अम्, n. execu-tion of orders, obedience. —आज्ञाकर-त्व, अम्, n. the office of a servant. —आज्ञा-कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, one who obeys or executes orders, obedient, minis-trant. —आज्ञा-चक्र, अम्, n. a mystical circle or dia-gram, one of six described by the Tantras. —आज्ञा-नुयायिन् or आज्ञानुवर्तिन् (°ज्ञा-अन्°), ई, इनी, इ, obeying or executing orders, obedient. —आज्ञानु-सारिन् (°ज्ञा-अन्°), ई, इणी, इ, executing orders, obe-dient. —आज्ञा-पत्त्र, अम्, n. an edict, written order. —आज्ञा-प्रतिघात अस्, m. disobedience, re-bellion. —आज्ञा-भङ्ग, अस्, m. disobedience, insub-ordination, disloyalty. —आज्ञा-वह, अस्, आ, अम्, obe-dient, subject, ministrant. —आज्ञा-सम्पादिन्, ई, इनी, इ, executing an order, obedient, submissive.
आज्ञप्त: आ-ज्ञप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, ordered, commanded.
आज्ञप्ति: आ-ज्ञप्ति, इस्, f. order, injunction, command.
आज्ञात: आ-ज्ञात, अस्, आ, अम्, ordered, commanded; (अस्), m., N. of one of the first five pupils of Śākya-muni.
आज्ञातृ: आ-ज्ञातृ, ता, m., Ved. one who orders or directs.
आज्ञान: आ-ज्ञान, अम्, n. the act of noticing, perceiving.
आज्ञापक: आ-ज्ञापक, अस्, आ, अम्, giving orders, commanding, a commander.
आज्ञापन: आ-ज्ञापन, अम्, n. ordering, commanding, making known.
आज्ञापित: आ-ज्ञापित, अस्, आ, अम्, ordered, commanded.
आज्ञाप्य: आ-ज्ञाप्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be directed or commanded.
आज्ञायिन्: आ-ज्ञायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, perceiving, understanding.
आज्य: आज्य आज्य, अम्, n. (fr. rt. अञ्ज् with आ), melted or clarified butter used for oblations, or for pouring into the holy fire at the sacrifice, or for anointing anything sacrificed or offered; (in a wider sense) oil and milk used instead of clarified butter at a sacrifice; N. of a sort of chant or religious service; turpentine. —आज्य-प, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. drinking the clarified butter; (आस्), m. pl. a class of Manes who are the sons of Pulastya and the ancestors of the Vaiśya order. —आज्य-पात्र, अम्, n. a vessel or dish to hold clarified butter. —आज्य-भाग, अस्, m. a portion of clarified butter; (औ), m. du. the two portions of clarified butter belonging to Agni and Soma; (अस्, आ, अम्), partaking of the clarified butter; offering clarified butter at certain ceremonies. —आज्य-भुज्, क्, m. ‘consumer of clarified butter,’ epithet of Agni. —आज्य-वारि, इस्, m. ‘sea of clarified butter,’ one of the seven seas. —आज्य-स्थाली, f., see आज्य-पात्र।
आञ्च्: आञ्च् आञ्च् (आ-अञ्च्), cl. 1. P. A. आञ्चति, -ते, -चितुम्, to bend, crook, curve.
आञ्चन: आञ्चन, अम्, n. partial extraction of thorns or arrows and the like from the body.
आञ्छ्: आञ्छ् आञ्छ्, cl. 1. P. आञ्छति, आञ्छ or आनाञ्छ, आञ्छितुम्, to make straight; to lengthen or stretch; to regulate, draw into the right position; to set (a bone or leg).
आञ्छन: आञ्छन, अम्, n. setting (a bone or leg), bringing back into the right place by stretching, bending, or drawing.
आञ्ज्: आञ्ज् आञ्ज् (आ-अञ्ज्), cl. 7. P. आनक्ति, आञ्जि-तुम् or आङ्क्तुम्, to anoint; to smooth, polish, pre-pare; to honour, receive respectfully.
आञ्जन: आञ्जन, अम्, ई, n. f. ointment, especially for the eyes; fat. —आञ्जनाभ्यञ्जनीय (°न-अभ्य्°), अम्, आ, n. f., N. of a certain ceremony. —आञ्जनी-कारी, f. a woman who anoints or makes ointments.
आञ्जन; add — (अस्, ई, अम्), having the colour of ointment.

आञ्जलिक्य: आञ्जलिक्य आञ्जलिक्य (fr. अञ्जलिक). See Gaṇa to Pāṇini V. 1. 128.
आञ्जिक: आञ्जिक आञ्जिक, अस्, m., N. of a Dānava.

आट: आट आट, अस्, m., N. of a serpent.
आटरूष: आटरूष आटरूष, अस्, m., N. of the tree Justicia Adhenatoda. See अटरूष or अटरूषक।

आत्मक: आत्मक, अस्, इका, m. f. = आत्मन्, essence, nature, character, property, peculiarity; (अस्, आ, अम्), belong-ing to the nature or essence of a thing, of the same nature as. आत्मक often occurs as the last member of a compound; e. g. सङ्कल्पात्मक, whose charac-teristic is सङ्कल्प; पञ्चात्मक, five-fold, com-posed of five; विषात्मक, poisonous; ऋग्-आत्मक, belonging to the Rig-veda.
आत्मकीय: आत्मकीय or आत्मीय, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging to one's self, one's own, own; cognate, related of kin. Used reflexively for all three persons.
आत्मनीन: आत्मनीन, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging to self, own; appropriate, good for, fit for, suitable (as diet &c.), existent, sentient; (अस्), m. a son; any living being; a wife's brother; the jester or Vidūṣaka (q. v.) in a drama.
आत्मनेपद: आत्मने-पद, अम्, n. ‘word to one's self,’ form for one's self; that form of the verb which implies an action belonging or reverting to self; that voice which corresponds to the Greek middle; the ter-minations of that voice.
आत्मनेपदिन्: आत्मनेपदिन्, ई, इनी, इ, taking the terminations of the middle voice, inflected in this voice.
आत्मनेभाषा: आत्मने-भाषा, f. the Sanskrit middle voice.
आत्मसात्कृ: आत्मसात्-कृ, to make one's own, to acquire or gain for one's self, to place upon one's self.
आत्मसात्कृत: आत्मसात्-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, made one's own, ap-propriated.
आत्मीभाव: आत्मी-भाव, अस्, m. becoming part of the supreme spirit.
आत्म्य: आत्म्य, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging to self, personal; (at the end of a comp.) having the nature of.
आत्यन्तिक: आत्यन्तिक आत्यन्तिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अत्य्-अन्त), continual, uninterrupted, infinite, endless; excessive, su-perlative, abundant; supreme. —आत्यन्तिक-प्रलय, अस्, m. the grand or universal destruction of the world.
आत्ययिक: आत्ययिक आत्ययिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अत्य्-अय), having a rapid course, rushing quickly to a termination, not suffering delay, pressing, urgent; destructive, dis-astrous, distressing, painful, ill-omened, unpropitious.
आत्यूह: आत्यूह आत्यूह, अस्, m. a gallinule. See दात्यूह।
आत्रेय: आत्रेय आत्रेय, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अत्रि), origin-ating from Atri; (अस्), m. a descendant of Atri; a priest who is closely related to the Sadasya (perhaps because this office was generally held by a descendant of Atri); an epithet of Śiva; an essential humor or juice of the body; (ई), f. a female descend-ant of Atri; a woman in her courses; any woman of the Brāhmanical order; N. of a river in the north of Bengal, otherwise called Tistā. —आत्रेयी-पुत्र, अस्, m., N. of a teacher.
आत्रेयिका: आत्रेयिका, f. a woman in her courses.
आथर्वण: आथर्वण आथर्वण, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अथर्वन्), originating from, or belonging or relating to Atharvan or the Atharvans; (अस्), m. a descendant of Atharvan; a priest whose ritual is comprised in the Atharva-veda; a Brāhman versed in the Atharva-veda; a house-priest; the Atharva-veda; (अम्), n. a private apartment in which, after a sacrifice, the sacrificer is informed of the happy event of the sacrifice by the officiating Brāhman.

आदष्ट: आ-दष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, nibbled, pecked at.
आदघ्न: आदघ्न आ-दघ्न, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. आस्-द्°), Ved. reaching up to the mouth (as water).
आदम्भ्: आदम्भ् आ-दम्भ्, cl. 5. P., Ved. -दभ्नोति, -दम्भितुम्, to harm, hurt, injure, treat injuriously.

आदह्: आदह् आ-दह्, cl. 1. P. -दहति, -दग्धुम्, to burn, burn up: Caus. -दाहयति, -यितुम्, to cause to burn: Caus. Pass. -दाह्यते, to be burnt.

आद: आ-द, अस्, आ, अम्, (at the end of some compounds) taking, receiving.

आदत्त: आ-दत्त, अस्, आ, अम् (sometimes contracted to आत्त, q. v.), taken, seized, put on; agreed to, under-taken, begun.

आदातव्य: आ-दातव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be taken or received.

आदापन: आ-दापन, अम्, n. inviting or causing another to accept something.

आदायिन्: आ-दायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, receiving, inclined to receive (gifts), taking gifts for one's self.
आदेय: आ-देय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be taken or received, re-ceivable, leviable.
आदेय आ-देय। See under 1. आ-दा last page.
आदादिक: आदादिक आदादिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अद्-आदि), belonging to that class of roots of which the first is अद्, i. e. to the second class.
आदि: आदि आदि, इस्, m. आदित्य: आदित्य, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging or devoted to, or originating from Aditi; belonging or relating to, or originating from the Ādityas; (अस्), m. a son of Aditi. In the earliest times this is the N. of seven deities of the heavenly sphere, of whom Varuṇa is the chief and to whom therefore especially belongs the title Āditya. The names of six of the seven are Varuṇa, Mitra, Aryaman, Bhaga, Dakṣa, and Aṃśa; that of the seventh is not clearly ascertained. Sometimes their number is supposed to be eight; and in the period of the Brāhmaṇas twelve, as representing the sun in the twelve months of the year. The name Āditya was afterwards applied to any god, though especially applicable to Sūrya, the sun; N. of Viṣṇu in his Vāmana or dwarf avatār, as son of Kaśyapa and Aditi and younger brother of Indra; the plant Calotropis Gigantea; N. of a man; (औ), m. du., N. of a constel-lation, the seventh lunar mansion. —आदित्य-केतु, उस्, m., N. of a son of Dhṛta-rāṣṭra. —आदित्य-गर्भ, अस्, m., N. of a Bodhi-sattva. —आदित्य-चन्द्रौ, m. du. sun and moon. —आदित्य-दास, अस्, m., N. of a man. —आदित्य-पत्त्र, अस्, m. a plant = अर्क-पत्त्र. —आदित्य-पर्णिनी, f. a creeping plant with gold-coloured flowers, growing near the banks of water. —आदित्य-पुराण, अम्, n., N. of an Upa-purāṇa. —आदित्य-पुष्पिका, f. red swallow wort. —आदित्य-प्रभ, अस्, m., N. of a king. —आदित्य-भक्ता, f. = अर्क-भक्ता, q. v. —आदित्य-मण्डल, अम्, n. the disc or orb of the sun. —आदित्य-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, surrounded by the Ādityas. —आदित्य-वनि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. winning the (favour of the) Ādityas. —आदित्य-वर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, having the colour of the sun; (अस्), m., N. of a man. —आदित्य-वर्मन्, आ, m., N. of a king. —आदित्य-व्रत, अम्, n. = अर्क-व्रत, q. v. —आदित्य-सदृश, अस्, ई, अम्, like the sun. —आदित्य-सूनु, उस्, m., son of the sun; N. of Sugrīva, the monkey-king; of Yama, Saturn, Sāvarṇi Manu, and Vaivasvata Manu. —आदित्य-सेन, अस्, m., N. of a king of Ujjayinī. —आदित्याचार्य (°त्य-आच्), अस्, m., N. of an author.

आपूर्यमाण: आ-पूर्यमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, becoming full, being filled. —आपूर्यमाण-पक्ष, अस्, m. the crescent or waxing moon.
आपेक्षिक: आपेक्षिक आपेक्षिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अपेक्षा), raising expectations.
आपोक्लिम: आपोक्लिम आपोक्लिम, अस्, m., in astronomy = Gr. ἀπόκλιμα
आपोमय: आपोमय आपो-मय, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. आपस्, nom. pl. of अप्, q. v.), consisting of water. —आपो-मात्रा, f. the subtle elementary principle of water. —आपो-मूर्ति, इस्, m., N. of a deity under Manu Svārociṣa, one of the seven Ṛṣis of the tenth Manvantara.
आपोशान: आपोशान आपोशान, अस्, m., N. of a kind of prayer spoken before and after eating; perhaps con-tracted from आपो ऽशान, ‘drink the water,’ with which words the prayer began.
आप्त्य: आप्त्य आप्त्य, अस्, m., Ved., N. of a class of deities, and especially of the deity Trita, as one of that class.
आप्यै: आप्यै आ-प्यै, cl. 1. A. -प्यायते, -प्यातुम्, to grow fat or comfortable, to increase, become full, enlarge: Caus. P. -प्याययति, -यितुम्, to make fat or comfortable; to enlarge.
आपीन: आ-पीन, अस्, आ, अम्, stout, fat; (अस्), m. a well; (अम्), n. an udder. —आपीन-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. containing the rt. प्यै with आ (said of a ऋच् or verse).
आप्यान: आ-प्यान, अस्, आ, अम्, stout, robust.
आप्याय: आ-प्याय, अस्, m. becoming full or fat.
आप्यायन: आप्यायन, अस्, आ, अम्, causing fulness or stout-ness, increasing welfare; (अम्), n. the act of making full or fat; satisfying, refreshing, pleasing; satiety, satisfaction; advancing; anything which causes cor-pulency or good condition; strengthening medicine; corpulency, growing or being fat or stout; (in certain ceremonies) the act of pouring water &c. on the Soma and so causing it to swell. —आप्यायन-शील, अस्, आ, अम्, satisfying.
आप्यायित: आ-प्यायित, अस्, आ, अम्, satisfied, increased, im-proved, pleased, gratified; stout, fat.
आप्र: आप्र आप्र, अस्, आ, अम्, (fr. rt. पॄ with आ ?), Ved. busy, zealous; (Sāy.) able to reach.
आप्रच्छ्: आप्रछ् आ-प्रछ्, cl. 6. A. or poet. P. -पृच्-छते, -ति, -प्रष्टुम्, to bid farewell; to salute on receiving or parting with a visitor; to extol.
आप्रछ्: आप्रछ् आ-प्रछ्, cl. 6. A. or poet. P. -पृच्-छते, -ति, -प्रष्टुम्, to bid farewell; to salute on receiving or parting with a visitor; to extol.
आपृच्छ्य: 1. आ-पृच्छ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. to be saluted, to be welcomed, to be honoured; laudable, commendable, beautiful.
2. आ-पृच्छ्य, ind. having saluted, having bid adieu. (In Rāmāyaṇa I. 72, 20, a form आ-पृष्ट्वा occurs.)
आप्रच्छन: आ-प्रच्छन, अम्, n. expressions of civility on re-ceiving or parting with a visitor, welcome, bidding adieu, &c.
आप्रतिनिवृत्त: आप्रतिनिवृत्त आ-प्रतिनिवृत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, pre-vented, turned back (?).
आप्रदिवम्: आप्रदिवम् आ-प्रदिवम्, ind., Ved. for ever.
आप्रपद: आप्रपद आ-प्रपद, अम्, n. a dress reaching to the feet; (अम्), ind. to the end of the foot, reaching to the feet.
आप्रपदीन: आप्रपदीन, अस्, आ, अम्, reaching from the shoulders to the feet (as a dress).
आप्रपदीनक: आप्रपदीनक, अम्, n. a dress reaching to the feet.
आप्रावृषम्: आप्रावृषम् आ-प्रावृषम्, ind. until the rainy season.
आप्री: आप्री आ-प्री, f. (fr. rt. प्री with आ), Ved. gaining one's favour, conciliation, propitiation; (आ-प्रि-यस्), propitiatory verses; N. of certain invocations addressed to a series of deified objects in order, and said to be introductory to the animal sacrifice. Accord-ing to others, the objects propitiated by these hymns are the real āprīs or आप्रियस्; whence the hymns themselves are called आप्री hymns. The objects in-voked are in a series of twelve verses, as follows: 1. Su-samiddha (or the fuel); 2. and 3. Tanūnapāt and Narāśaṃsa (these are sometimes invoked in one verse as mystic names of fire); 4. The divine being who bears the invocations to the gods (see under इड्); 5. Barhis (or the sacred grass); 6. The doors of the chambers in which the sacrifice is offered; 7. Night and dawn; 8. The two divine beings, sometimes called Pracetasas, who preside over and protect the sacrificial rite; 9. The three goddesses, Ilā (see under इडा), Sarasvatī (goddess of eloquence), and Mahī (a form of Bhāratī or speech); 10. Tvaṣṭṛ (the maker or creator); 11. Vanas-pati (the tree or wooden column to which the victim is tied); 12. Svāhā (the exclama-tion used in inviting the gods to the sacrifice when finally offered in the fire). All these are by Sāy. re-garded as forms of Agni. See Ṛg-veda I. 13.
आप्रीतपा: आ-प्रीत-पा, आस्, m., Ved. epithet of Viṣṇu, ‘guard-ing those who have appeased his anger.’
आप्लु: आप्लु आ-प्लु, cl. 1. A. -प्लवते, -प्लोतुम्, to bathe, wash, immerse one's self; to jump up, dance: Caus. P. -प्लावयति, -यितुम्, to cause to be bathed or washed; to wash or wet; to overflow, overwhelm; to set in commotion; A. -प्लावयते, to bathe.
आप्लव: आ-प्लव, अस्, m. bathing, sprinkling with water. —आप्लव-व्रतिन्, ई, m. an initiated householder, who has passed through the first order (Brahma-cārin), and is admitted into the second. See स्नातक।
आप्लवन: आ-प्लवन, अम्, n. immersing, bathing, sprinkling with water.
आप्लाव: आ-प्लाव, अस्, m. bathing, sprinkling, wetting; a submerging; a flood, an inundation.
आप्लावित: आ-प्लावित, अस्, आ, अम्, inundated, overflowed.
आप्लाव्य: आ-प्लाव्य, ind. having wetted or sprinkled.
आप्लुत: आ-प्लुत, अस्, आ, अम्, bathed; wetted, sprinkled. In comp. sometimes used figuratively (e. g. स्नेहा-प्लुत, overflowing with affection); (अस्), m. an ini-tiated householder, see आप्लव-व्रतिन्; (अम्), n. bathing. —आप्लुत-व्रतिन्, ई, m. an initiated house-holder; see आप्लव-व्रतिन्. —आप्लुताङ्ग (°त-अङ्°), अस्, ई, अम्, bathed all over.
आप्लुत्य: आ-प्लुत्य, ind. having bathed, having washed; having jumped up.
आप्वन्: आप्वन् आप्वन्, आ, m. (fr. rt. आप्), air, wind.
आप्सव: आप्सव आप्सव, अस्, m. (fr. अप्सु, loc. pl. of अप्), epithet of a Manu.
आफूक: आफूक आफूक, अम्, n. opium. See 2. अ-फेन।
आबन्ध्: आबन्ध् आ-बन्ध्, cl. 9. P. -बध्नाति, -बन्द्-धुम्, to bind or tie on.
आबद्ध: आ-बद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, tied, bound, joined; (अस्), m. a binding, a yoke; ornament; affection. —आबद्-ध-माल, अस्, आ, अम्, forming a wreath.
आबन्ध: आ-बन्ध, अस्, m. a tie or bond; the tie of a yoke, that which fastens the ox to the yoke, or the latter to the plough; ornament, decoration; affection.
आबन्धन: आ-बन्धन, अम्, n. tying, binding on or round.
आबयु: आबयु आबयु, उस्, Ved., perhaps the N. of a plant.
आबर्ह: आबर्ह आ-बर्ह, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. वृह् or बृह् with आ), having the property or power of tearing or pulling out; (अस्), m. tearing out.
आबर्हण: आ-बर्हण, अम्, n. the act of tearing out.
आबर्हिन्: आ-बर्हिन्, ई, इणी, इ, fit for tearing out.
आबल्य: आबल्य आबल्य, अम्, n. (fr. अ-बल), weakness.
आबाध्: आबाध् आ-बाध्, cl. 1. A. -बाधते, -धितुम्, to check, rein in, restrain; to interrupt, molest, attack.
आबाध: आ-बाध, अस्, m., Ved. attack; molestation, trouble, interruption, damage; (आ), f. pain, distress, segment of the base of a triangle.
आबाल्य: आबाल्य आ-बाल्य, अम्, n. age ending with infancy.
आबिलम्: आबिलम् आ-बिलम्, ind., Ved. to the hole or aperture [cf. विल].
आबुत्त: आबुत्त आबुत्त, अस्, m. (perhaps corrupted fr. आर्य-पुत्र), a sister's husband (in theatrical lan-guage).
आबुध्: आबुध् आ-बुध्, cl. 1. P., Ved. -बोधति, -बोद्धुम्, to perceive, notice, understand.
आबोधन: आ-बोधन, अम्, n. knowledge, understanding; instructing, informing.
आब्दिक: आब्दिक आब्दिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अब्द), annual, yearly.
आभज्: आभज् आ-भज्, cl. 1. P., Ved. -भजति, -भक्-तुम्, to make one share, cause one to partake.
आभग: आ-भग, अस्, m., Ved. a partaker of (with loc.); (Sāy.) to be shared in.
आभरण: आभरण आ-भरण, अम्, n. See under आ-भृ।
आ-भरण, अम्, n. ornament, decoration (as jewels &c.); act of nourishing; title of several works.
आभा: आभा 1. आ-भा, cl. 2. P. -भाति, -तुम्, to shine, blaze; to irradiate; to outshine; to appear, to look like.

2. आ-भा, f. splendor, light; a flash; colour, appear-ance, beauty; a reflected image, shade; likeness, resemblance: (अस्, आ, अम्, at the end of compounds) like, resembling, appearing; e. g. हेमाभ, अस्, आ, अम्, shining like gold; [cf. Hib. aoibh, ‘likeness, similitude;’ aoibe, ‘neatness, elegance;’ aoibheal, ‘a spark of fire.’]
आभाति: आ-भाति, इस्, f. splendor, light; shade.
आभाष्: आभाष् आ-भाष्, cl. 1. A. -भाषते, -षितुम्, to address, speak to; to talk, shout.
आभाष: आ-भाष, अस्, m. addressing; introduction, preface.
आभाषण: आ-भाषण, अम्, n. addressing, speaking to.
आभाष्य: 1. आ-भाष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be addressed, worthy of being spoken to.
2. आ-भाष्य, ind. having addressed, having spoken to.
आभास्: आभास् 1. आ-भास्, cl. 1. A. -भासते, -सितुम्, to shine, blaze; to be bright: Caus. -भासयति, -यितुम्, to illuminate.
आभास: आ-भास, अस्, m. splendor, light, colour, appear-ance; semblance, phantom; mere appearance; falla-cious appearance; reflection; intention, purpose; (in logic) fallacy, semblance of a reason, sophism, an erro-neous though plausible argument (regarded by logi-cians as of various kinds).
आभासन: आ-भासन, अम्, n. illuminating, making apparent or clear.
आभासुर: आ-भासुर, अस्, m., N. of a class of deities or demi-gods, sixty in number.
आभास्वर: आ-भास्वर, अस्, m. a demi-god, of a class consist-ing of sixty-four.
आभिचरणिक: आभिचरणिक आभिचरणिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अभि-चरण), maledictory, imprecatory, serving for malediction or cursing.
आभिचारिक: आभिचारिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अभि-चार), magical, relating to magic; (अम्), n. incantation, magic.
आभिजन: आभिजन आभिजन, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अभि-जन, rt. जन्), relating to descent; (अम्), n. loftiness of birth.
आभिजात्य: आभिजात्य, अम्, n. (fr. अभि-जात, rt. जन्), the nature or state of a man of noble birth, nobility; birth, family, rank, learning.
आभिजित: आभिजित आभिजित, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अभि-जित्), born under the constellation Abhijit.
आभिधा: आभिधा आभिधा, f. or आभिधातक, अम्, n. a sound, a word, a name. See अभि-धा।
आभिधानिक: आभिधानिक, अस्, ई, अम्, contained in a dictionary, lexicographical; (अस्), m. a lexicographer.
आभिधानीयक: आभिधानीयक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अभि-धान), re-lating or belonging to a name or word; (अम्), n. the property of a name.
आभिप्लविक: आभिप्लविक आभिप्लविक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अभि-प्लव), relating to the religious ceremony called Abhi-plava.
आभिमुख्य: आभिमुख्य आभिमुख्य, अम्, n. (fr. अभि-मुख), direction towards anything; wish or desire directed towards anything; presence, being in front of or face to face.
आभिषेचनिक: आभिषेचनिक आभिषेचनिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अभि-षेचन), relating to the inauguration of a king; serving for it.
आभिहारिक: आभिहारिक आभिहारिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अभि-हार), taken by force or fraud; (अम्), n. a room.
आभीक: आभीक आभीक, अम्, n., N. of a Sāma melody.
आभीक्ष्ण: आभीक्ष्ण आभीक्ष्ण, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अभीक्ष्ण), much, exceeding, eternal; (अम्), ind. exceedingly, eternally.
आभीय: आभीय आभीय, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. आ-भात्, ‘up to भ’), contained in a chapter of Pāṇini which ends with भ।
आभीर: आभीर आभीर, अस्, m., N. of a people; a cowherd sprung from a Brāhman and female of the Ambaṣṭha or medical tribe; N. of a metre; (ई), f. a cowherd's wife or woman of the Ābhīra tribe; the language of the Ābhīra. —आभीर-पल्लि, इस् or ई or इका, f. a station of herdsmen, a village inhabited by cowherds only, an abode of cowherds &c.
आभील: आभील आ-भील, अस्, आ, अम्, (fr. rt. भी with आ), formidable, fearful; suffering pain; (अम्), n. bodily pain; [cf. Hib. abhéil, ‘terrible, dreadful.’]
आभु: आभु आभु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. empty; one whose hands are empty; stingy; (Sāy.) pervading, reaching.
आभूक: आभूक, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. empty, having no con-tents, powerless.
आभुग्न: आभुग्न आ-भुग्न, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. 1. भुज् with 3. आ implying diminution), a little curved or bent.
आभू: आभू 1. आ-भू, cl. 1. P. -भवति, -वितुम्, to be present, continue one's existence.
2. आ-भू, ऊस्, ऊस्, उ, Ved. strong, sufficient, effica-cious; (Sāy.) approaching (as a praiser); a prison, a place of confinement; applied according to rule (as a hymn); very prosperous.
आभूति: आ-भूति, इस्, f., Ved. capability, efficiency; (Sāy.) overpowering strength; (इस्), m., N. of a man.
आभूषेण्य: आ-भूषेण्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. to be obeyed; (Sāy.) praiseworthy.
आभूष्: आभूष् आ-भूष्, cl. 1. P., Ved. -भूषति, -षितुम्, to adorn, to adorn with one's presence, i. e. to come.
आभृ: आभृ आ-भृ, cl. 1. P., Ved. -भरति, -भर्-तुम्, to bring; to carry; to bear; to support.
आभरत्: आ-भरत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, bringing. —आभरद्-वसु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. bringing property, goods, &c.; (उस्), m., N. of a man.
आभेरी: आभेरी आभेरी, f. one of the Rāgiṇīs or modes of music, personified as a female.
आभोग: आभोग 1. आ-भोग, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 1. भुज्, to curve, bend, with prep. आ), winding, curving, curve, crease; crumpling; circuit, circumference, en-virons, extension, fulness, expanse; a serpent; the expanded hood of the Cobra Capella (used by Varuṇa as his umbrella); effort, pains.
आभोग 2. आ-भोग, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 2. भुज्, to eat, enjoy), enjoyment, satiety, fulness, comple-tion.
आभोगय: आ-भोगय, अम्, n., Ved. means of supporting life, livelihood; (Sāy.) to be enjoyed (as Soma juice).
आभोगि: आ-भोगि, इस्, f., Ved. living, supporting life; (Sāy.) enjoyment.
आभ्यन्तर: आभ्यन्तर आभ्यन्तर, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अभ्य्-अन्तर), being inside, interior, inner.
आभ्यवकाशिक: आभ्यवकाशिक आभ्यवकाशिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अभ्य्-अवकाश), living in the open air.
आभ्याशिक: आभ्याशिक आभ्याशिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अभ्य्-आश), being near to each other, neighbouring; (less correctly in this sense written आभ्यासिक।)
आभ्यासिक: आभ्यासिक आभ्यासिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अभ्य्-आस), resulting from practice, practising, repeating.
आभ्युदयिक: आभ्युदयिक आभ्युदयिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अभ्य्-उदय), connected with the rising or begin-ning of anything; relating to or granting prosperity; high, exalted, important; (अम्), n. a Śrāddha or offer-ing to ancestors on occasions of rejoicing.
आभ्रिक: आभ्रिक आभ्रिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अभ्रि), one who digs with a spade or a hoe.
आम्: आम् आम्, ind. an interjection of assent or recollection, (a vocative following this particle is अनु-दात्त।)
आम: आम 1. आम, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. 2. अम्?), raw, uncooked (the opposite to पक्व, q. v.; in the Veda often an epithet of the cow considered as the raw material which produces the milk); unbaked, unan-nealed; undressed; unripe, immature; undigested; (अम्), n. condition of being raw; constipation, pass-ing hard and unhealthy excretions; grain freed from chaff; [cf. Gr. ὠμό-ς Hib. amh, ‘raw, unsodden, crude, unripe.’] —आम-कुम्भ, अस्, m. a water-jar of unbaked clay. —आम-गन्धि, n. smell of raw meat or of a burning corpse. —आम-गन्धिक, अम्, n. the smell of raw meat. —आम-ता, f. rawness, un-readiness. —आम-त्वच्, क्, क्, क्, tender-skinned. —आम-पात्र, अम्, n. an unannealed vessel. —आम-पीनस, अम्, n. running at the nose, defluxion. —आम-मांस, अस्, m. raw flesh. —आममांसाशिन् (°स-आश्°), ई, m. a cannibal, eater of raw flesh. —आम-रक्त, अस्, m. dysentery. —आम-रस, अस्, m. imperfect chyme. —आम-वात, अस्, m. constipa-tion or torpor of the bowels with flatulence and intu-mescence. —आम-शूल, अस्, m. the cholic, pain arising from indigestion. —आमातिसार (°म-अत्°), अस्, m. dysentery or diarrhœa produced by vitiated mucus in the abdomen; the excretion being mixed with hard and fetid matter. —आमाद् (°म-अद्), त्, त्, त्, eating raw flesh or food. —आमान्न (°म-अन्°), अम्, n. undressed rice. —आमाशय (°म-आश्°), अस्, m. the receptacle of the undigested food, the upper part of the belly to the navel, the stomach.
आम 2. आम, अस्, m. or आमन, अम्, n. (fr. rt. 2. अम्), sickness, disease.
आमक: आमक, अस्, आ, अम्, raw, uncooked, &c. See 1. आम।
आमिष: आमिष, अम्, n. flesh. See s. v. next col.

आमिष आमिष, अम्, n. (connected with 1. आम), flesh, enjoyment; an object of enjoyment, a pleasing or beautiful object &c.; a bribe; coveting, longing for; lust, desire; food; form. —आमिष-प्रिय, अस्, आ, अम्, fond of flesh-meat, carnivorous; (अस्), m. a heron. —आमिष-भुज्, क्, क्, क्, carni-vorous. —आमिषाशिन् (°ष-आश्°), ई, इनी, इ, carni-vorous, eating flesh and fish.
आमय: आमय, अस्, m. damage, hurt; disease, sickness; indigestion; (अम्), n., N. of the medical plant Cos-tus Speciosus.
आमयाविन्: आमयाविन्, ई, इनी, इ, sick, diseased, affected with indigestion, dyspeptic. —आमयावि-त्व, अम्, n. indi-gestion, dyspepsia.
आमण्ड: आमण्ड आमण्ड, अस्, m. the castor-oil plant [cf. अमण्ड and मण्ड].
आमन: आमन आ-मन, अम्, n. (rt. मन्), Ved. friendly disposition, inclination, affection.
आमनस्: आ-मनस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, friendly disposed, kind, favourable.
आमनस्य: आमनस्य आमनस्य or आमानस्य, अम्, n. (fr. अ-मनस्), pain.
आमन्त्र्: आमन्त्र् आ-मन्त्र्, cl. 10. A. -मन्त्रयते, -यितुम्, to address, especially in saluting and in bid-ding farewell; to ask, invite.
आमन्त्रण: आ-मन्त्रण, अम्, आ, n. f. addressing, speaking to, calling or calling to; greeting, courtesy, welcome, bidding adieu, taking leave; inviting, invitation; de-liberation, interrogation; the vocative case.
आमन्त्रणीय: आ-मन्त्रणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. to be addressed or asked, to be asked for advice or consulted.
आमन्त्रयितृ: आ-मन्त्रयितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, asking, inviting, call-ing; (ता), m. an inviter, entertainer, especially of Brāhmans.
आमन्त्रित: आ-मन्त्रित, अस्, आ, अम्, invited, summoned, called; (अम्), n. addressing; the vocative case.
आमन्त्र्य: 1. आ-मन्त्र्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be addressed or called to; to be invited; (अम्), n. a word standing in the vocative case.
2. आ-मन्त्र्य, ind. having taken leave, bidding farewell.
आमन्थ्: आमन्थ् आ-मन्थ् or आ-मथ्, cl. 1. P. -मन्-थति, -थितुम्, to agitate.
आमन्द्र: आमन्द्र आ-मन्द्र, अस्, आ, अम्, having a slightly deep tone, making a low muttering sound (like thunder).
आमरणान्त: आमरणान्त आ-मरणान्त, अस्, आ, अम्, or आ-म-रणान्तिक (°ण-अन्त्°), अस्, ई, अम्, having death as the limit, continuing till death, lasting for life.
आमरितृ: आमरितृ आ-मरितृ, ता, m. (rt. मृ or मृण् with आ), Ved. one who hurts or destroys; a de-stroyer.
आमर्द: आ-मर्द, अस्, m. crushing, handling roughly; press-ing, squeezing; N. of a town.
आमर्ष: आमर्ष आ-मर्ष, अस्, m. (for अ-मर्ष, q. v.), impatience, anger, wrath. (For आ-मर्श see under आ-मृश्।)
आमलक: आमलक आमलक, अस्, ई, अम्, m. f. n. the plant Emblic Myrobalan, Emblica Officinalis Gærtn.; (अस्), m. another plant, Gendarussa Adhatoda; (अम्), n. the fruit of the Emblic Myrobalan.
आमहीया: आमहीया आमहीया, f. designation of a particular (ऋच्) verse of the Ṛg-veda (viz. Ṛg-veda VIII. 48, 3).
आमहीयव: आमहीयव, अस्, m., N. of a Ṛṣi.
आमा: आमा आ-मा, cl. 3. A. -मिमीते, -मातुम्, to effect, accomplish.
आमात्य: आमात्य आमात्य, अस्, m. a minister, a coun-sellor, an adviser; a general. See अमात्य।
आमालक: आमालक आमालक, अस्, अम्, m. n. land near a mountain (?).
आमावास्य: आमावास्य आमावास्य, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अमा-वास्या), belonging to the new moon or its festival; born at the time of new moon; occurring on the day of conjunction; (अम्), n. the new moon oblation.
आमिक्षा: आमिक्षा आमिक्षा, f. curd of two-milk whey, a mixture of boiled and coagulated milk.
आमिक्ष्य: आमिक्ष्य or आमिक्षीय, अस्, आ, अम्, suitable for the preparation of Āmikṣā; made of curds.
आमित्र: आमित्र आमित्र, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अ-मित्र), pro-duced by an enemy, inimical, odious.
आमिश्ल: आमिश्ल आ-मिश्ल, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having a tendency to mix, readily mixing.
आमिस्: आमिस्, m. (occurring in loc. c. आमिषि), Ved. raw flesh, meat; a dead body.
आमी: आमी आ-मी, cl. 9. P., Ved. -मिनाति, -मातुम्, to destroy, neutralize, curtail; A. -मिनीते, to destroy or neutralize mutually.
आमीक्षा: आमीक्षा आमीक्षा, f. = आमिक्षा, q. v.
आमील्: आमील् आ-मील्, cl. 1. P. -मीलति, -लितुम्, to close the eyes.
आमीलन: आ-मीलन, अम्, n. closing of the eyes.
आमीवत्: आमीवत् आ-मीवत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, or आमीवत्क, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. attacking, pressing.
आमुख: आमुख आ-मुख, अम्, n. commencement; prelude, prologue; (अम्), ind. to the face.
आमुच्: आमुच् आ-मुच्, cl. 6. P. -मुञ्चति, -मोक्तुम्, to loosen, let go; to put on a garment.
आमुक्त: आ-मुक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, loosed, let go; liberated; discharged, cast, shot off; put on as clothes or armour; dressed, accoutred.
आमुक्ति: आ-मुक्ति, इस्, f. liberation, the being let loose; final liberation; (इ), ind. to the end of existence.
आमोचन: आ-मोचन, अम्, n. the act of loosing, liberating; emitting, shedding, letting forth, putting or tying on.
आमुप: आमुप आमुप, अस्, m. the cane Bambusa Spinosa Hamilt. Roxb.
आमुर्: आमुर् आ-मुर्, ऊर्, or आ-मुरि, इस्, m. (fr. rt. मृ with आ), Ved. destroying, hurting.
आमुष्मिक: आमुष्मिक आमुष्मिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अमुष्-मिन्, loc. of 1. अदस्), of that state, being there, belonging to the other world.
आमुष्यकुलक: आमुष्यकुलक, अम्, n., आमुष्यपुत्रक, अम्, n., Gaṇa to Pāṇini V. 1. 133.
आमुष्यायण: आमुष्यायण, अस्, m. (fr. अमुष्य, gen. of 1. अदस्), son or descendant of such a one, son or descendant of an illustrious person; (अस्, ई, अम्), well-born, well descended.
आमूलम्: आमूलम् आ-मूलम्, ind. to the root, by the root, entirely, radically.
आमृज्: आमृज् आ-मृज्, cl. 1. 2. P. -मार्जति, -मार्ष्टि, मार्जितुम्, -मार्ष्टुम्, to wipe, rub.
आमृज्य: आ-मृज्य, ind. having wiped or rubbed.
आमृष्ट: आ-मृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, wiped, rubbed.
आमृण: आमृण आ-मृण, अस्, आ, अम्, vulnerable. See अन्-आमृण।
आमृत: आमृत आ-मृत, अस्, आ, अम्, (fr. rt. मृ with आ), mortal.
आमृद्: आमृद् आ-मृद्, cl. 9. P. -मृद्नाति, -मर्दि-तुम्, to crush by rubbing; to crumple; to press, to squeeze.
आमर्दिन्: आ-मर्दिन्, ई, इनी, इ, crushing; pressing.
आमृश्: आमृश् आ-मृश्, cl. 6. P. -मृशति, -मर्ष्टुम् or -म्रष्टुम्, to touch, handle roughly, rub, injure.
आ-मृश्; add — Pass. मृश्यते, to be devoured or eaten (= भक्ष्यते, Raghu-v. V. 9).
आमर्शन: आ-मर्शन, or less correctly आ-मर्षण, अम्, n. rubbing, wiping.
आमेन्य: आमेन्य आ-मेन्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. मेनि with आ), Ved. to be reached with an arrow or bolt; (Sāy.) to be measured from all sides.
आमोक्षण: आमोक्षण आ-मोक्षण, अम्, n. the act of fixing or tying on or to.
आमोद: आमोद आ-मोद, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. मुद् with आ), gladdening, cheering up; (अस्), m. joy, serenity, pleasure; fragrancy, a diffusive perfume; strong smell.
आमोदित: आ-मोदित, अस्, आ, अम्, pleased, delighted, fragrant.
आमोदिन्: आ-मोदिन्, ई, इनी, इ, fragrant; happy, delighted; (at the end of compounds) fragrant or perfumed with, e. g. कदम्बामोदिन्, perfumed with kadambas; (ई), m. a perfume for the mouth made up in the form of a pill or bolus of camphor &c.
आमोष: आमोष आ-मोष, अस्, m. (fr. rt. मुष् with आ), robbing, stealing.
आमोषिन्: आ-मोषिन्, ई, इणी, इ, who or what steals, a thief.
आमोहनिका: आमोहनिका आ-मोहनिका, f. (fr. rt. मुह् with आ), a particular fragrant odour.
आम्ना: आम्ना आ-म्ना, cl. 1. P., Ved. -मनति, -म्ना-तुम्, to keep in mind, to repeat, commit to memory, hand down in sacred texts; to celebrate, to hail.
आम्नात: आ-म्नात, अस्, आ, अम्, kept in mind, remembered, committed to memory, learnt by heart, repeated, handed down in sacred texts, celebrated.
आम्नान: आ-म्नान, अम्, n. mention, repetition, handing down by sacred texts.
आम्नाय: आ-म्नाय, अस्, m. sacred tradition, sacred texts handed down by repetition; that which is to be re-membered, studied or learnt by heart; a Veda or the Vedas in the aggregate; received doctrine; traditional usage, family or national customs; advice, instruction in past and present usage; a Tantra; an element of being, a property of substance (?); a family, series of families. —आम्नाय-सारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, observing the Vedas and traditional customs, pious; containing the essence of the Veda.
आम्प्रत्यय: आम्प्रत्यय आम्-प्रत्यय, अस्, आ, अम्, having आम् for its affix (e. g. a root like ईश्).
आम्बरीषपुत्रक: आम्बरीषपुत्रक आम्बरीषपुत्रक, अस्, m. a country inhabited by the Ambarīṣa-putras.
आम्बष्ठ: आम्बष्ठ आम्बष्ठ, अस्, m. an inhabitant of Ambaṣṭha.
आम्बिकेय: आम्बिकेय आम्बिकेय, अस्, m. (fr. अम्बिका), an epithet of Dhṛta-rāṣṭra; also of Kārttikeya.
आम्भस: आम्भस आम्भस, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. 2. अम्भस्), watery, fluid.
आम्भसिक: आम्भसिक, अस्, ई, अम्, living in water, aquatic; (अस्), m. a fish.
आम्भृणी: आम्भृणी आम्भृणी, f. a N. of Vāc, the daughter of the Ṛṣi Ambhṛṇa. See 3. अम्भृण।
आम्र: आम्र आम्र, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. 2. अम्), the mango tree, Mangifera Indica; (अम्), n. the fruit of the mango tree. —आम्र-कूट, अस्, m., N. of a mountain. —आम्र-गन्धक, अस्, m., N. of a plant. —आम्र-गुप्त, अस्, m., N. of a man. —आम्र-पाली, f., N. of a woman. —आम्र-पेशी, f. a portion of dried mango fruit. —आम्र-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, made of mangoes (as sauce). —आम्र-वण, अम्, n. a mango forest. —आम्रावर्त (°र-आव्°), अस्, m. in-spissated mango juice.
आम्रात: आम्रात, अस्, m. the hog-plum, Spondias Mangi-fera.
आम्रातक: आम्रातक, अस्, m. the hog-plum, Spondias Mangi-fera; inspissated mango juice; N. of a mountain.
आम्रावती: आम्रावती, f., N. of a town.
आम्रिमन्: आम्रिमन्, आ, m., Gaṇa to Pāṇini V. 1, 123.
आम्रेडन: आम्रेडन आ-म्रेडन, अम्, n. tautology, re-iteration of words or sounds.
आम्रेडित: आ-म्रेडित, अस्, आ, अम्, reiterated, repeated; (अम्), n. repetition of a sound or word; (in gram.) redu-plication, the second word in reduplications.
आम्ल: आम्ल आम्ल, अस्, आ, m. f. (fr. अम्ल), the tamarind tree, Tamarindus Indica; (अम्), n. sour-ness, acidity. —आम्ल-वेतस, अस्, m. the plant Rumex Vesicatorius.
आम्लिका: आम्लिका, f. the tamarind tree; sourness in the mouth, acidity of stomach.
आय: आय आय, अस्, m. (fr. rt. इ with आ), arrival, approach; income, revenue; gain, profit; the guard of the women's apartments; the eleventh lunar man-sion. —आय-व्यय, अम् or औ, n. or m. du. receipt and disbursement, income and expenditure. —आय-स्थान, अम्, n. a place where revenues are collected.
आयत्: 1. आ-यत्, अन्, अती, अत्, coming, approaching. —आयती-गवम्, ind. at the time when the cows come home. —आयद्-वसु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. one to whom goods come.
आयत् 2. आ-यत्, cl. 1. A. -यतते, -तितुम्, to make effort; to rest on, to depend on, to have the upper hand (?).
आयिन्: आयिन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. driving near.
आयःशूलिक: आयःशूलिक आयःशूलिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अयः-शूल), active, diligent, indefatigable; (अस्), m. a man who, in order to obtain an object, uses forcible instead of gentle means; as, for instance, a beggar who holds a lance to your breast in asking for alms.
आयज्: आयज् आ-यज्, cl. 1. A. -यजते, -यष्टुम्, to honour (the gods); to give, present.
आयजि: आ-यजि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. procuring, granting; (Sāy.) accomplishing sacrifices from all sides.
आयजिष्ठ: आ-यजिष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. procuring most or best; (Sāy.) sacrificing best.
आयज्यु: आ-यज्यु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. endeavouring to gain; inclined to sacrifice.
आयाग: आ-याग, अस्, m. a gift given at a sacrifice. —आया-ग-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, obtained by sacrifice.

आयत्त: आ-यत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, dependant, tractable, docile. —अयत्त-ता, f. or आयत्त-त्व, अम्, n. dependence, humility, tractableness, docility.
आयत्ति: आ-यत्ति, इस्, f. dependence, subjection, subjecting; affection; power, strength; day; boundary, limit; sleeping; length (? for आ-यति below); majesty, dignity; future time (? for आ-यति); continuance in the right way, steadiness of conduct.
आयथातथ्य: आयथातथ्य आयथातथ्य, अम्, n. (fr. अ-य-थातथ), unsuitableness, unfitness, incompatibility.

आयत: आ-यत, अस्, आ, अम्, long; diffuse, prolix; (अस्), m. an oblong figure (in geometry). —आयत-च्छदा, f. the plantain tree Musa Paradisiaca Lin. —आयत-स्तू, ऊस्, m. a panegyrist. —आयताक्ष (°त-अक्°), अस्, ई, अम्, having large eyes or long eyelids. —आयता-पाङ्ग (°त-अप्°), अस्, ई, अम्, having a long-cornered eye. —आयतायति (°त-आय्°), इस्, f. long continu-ance, remote futurity. —आयतार्ध (°त-अर्ध्°), अस्, m. Vājīkaraṇa-tantra, rules for increasing generative power. —आयुर्वेद-दृश्, क्, m. a physician. —आयुर्वेद-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, acquainted with medical science. —आयुर्वेदिक, अस्, m. acquainted or familiar with medical science, a physician. —आयुर्वेदिन्, ई, इनी, इ, belonging to medicine, of the medical profession, medical, medicinal, &c.; (ई), m. a practiser of physic, a physician or surgeon. —आयुष्-काम, अस्, आ, अम्, wishing for life or health. —आयुष्-कृत्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. producing or creating life. —अयुष्टोम, अस्, m. आर्वाक्: आर्वाक् आर्वाक्, ind. after, afterwards, be-hind. See अर्वाक्।
आर्श: आर्श आर्श, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. ऋश्य), Ved. belong-ing to the antelope.
आर्ष: आर्ष आर्ष, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. ऋषि), relating or belonging to or derived from Ṛṣis, i. e. the poets of the Vedic and other old hymns, archaistic; (अस्), m. a form of marriage derived from the Ṛṣis, the father of the bride receiving one or two pairs of kine from the bridegroom; (अम्), n. the speech of a Ṛṣi, the holy text, the Vedas; sacred descent; the derivation (of a poem) from a Ṛṣi author; (आ), f. a class of Vedic metres. —आर्षोढा (°ष-ऊढ्°), f. a wife married according to the Ārṣa form.
आर्षेय: आर्षेय, अस्, ई, अम्, relating or belonging to or derived from a Ṛṣi, of sacred descent; venerable, respectable; (अम्), n. sacred descent. —आर्षेय-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. connected with sacred descent.
आर्षभ: आर्षभ आर्षभ, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. ऋषभ), derived from a bull, produced by one.
आर्षभि: आर्षभि, इस्, m., N. of the first Cakravartin in Bhārata; a son of the first Tīrthakṛt Ṛṣabha.
आर्षभ्य: आर्षभ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, a steer sufficiently full-grown to be used or one fit to be castrated.
आर्ष्टिषेण: आर्ष्टिषेण आर्ष्टिषेण, अस्, m. a patronymic of Devāpi.
आर्हत: आर्हत आर्हत, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अर्हत्), belong-ing to the doctrine of Jina or the Jains; (अस्), m. a Jaina, a follower of the doctrines of Jina.
आर्हत्य: आर्हत्य, अम्, n. the quality or practice of an Arhat or Jain saint.
आल: आल आल, अम्, n. spawn, any discharge of venomous matter from poisonous animals; yellow arsenic, orpiment; (अस्, आ, अम्), not small, large, ex-tensive. —आलाक्त (°ल-अक्°), अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. anointed with poison (as an arrow).
आलक्ष्: आलक्ष् आ-लक्ष्, cl. 10. P. A. -लक्षयति, -ते, -यितुम्, to descry, behold.

आलक्षण्य: आलक्षण्य आलक्षण्य, अम्, n. (fr. अ-ल-क्षण), misfortune, crime.
आलगर्द: आलगर्द आलगर्द, अस्, m. a species of Cobra. See अलगर्द।
आलप्: आलप् आ-लप्, cl. 1. P. -लपति, -पितुम्, to address, speak to, converse: Caus. -लापयति, -यितुम्, to engage (another) in conversation, to question.
आलाप: आ-लाप, अस्, m. speaking to, addressing, speech, conversation, communication; statement of the ques-tion in an arithmetical or algebraic sum; a question. —आलाप-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, speaking, addressing.
आलापन: आ-लापन, अस्, आ, अम्, causing to speak or converse about; (अम्), n. speaking to, conversing with.
आलापनीय: आ-लापनीय or आ-लाप्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be said or spoken, to be spoken to or addressed.
आलापिन्: आ-लापिन्, ई, इनी, इ, speaking or conversing with; (इनी), f. a lute made of a gourd.

आलभन: आ-लभन, अम्, n. taking hold of, bringing (?).
आलभ्य: 1. आ-लभ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. fit to be killed or sacrificed.

आलम्भ: आ-लम्भ, अस्, m. taking hold of, seizing, touching; tearing off, rooting out (of plants); the killing of the animal at a sacrifice.
आलम्भन: आ-लम्भन, अम्, n. taking hold of, touching; killing.
आलम्भनीय: आ-लम्भनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be taken hold of or handled, to be touched.
आलम्भिन्: आ-लम्भिन्, ई, इनी, इ, touching, taking hold of.
आलम्भ्य: आ-लम्भ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, obtainable, to be obtained; fit or proper to be killed.
आलम्ब्: आलम्ब् आ-लम्ब्, cl. 1. A. -लम्बते, -बितुम्, to rest or lean upon; to hang from; to depend; to lay hold of, support, seize; to strike up (a tune or note).
आलम्ब: आ-लम्ब, अस्, आ, अम्, hanging down; (अस्), m. that on which one rests or leans; support; receptacle; a prop; an asylum; depending on or from; a per-pendicular; (आ), f., N. of a plant with poisonous leaves.

आलम्बायन: आलम्बायन or आलम्बायनी-पुत्र, अस्, m., N. of a teacher.
आलम्बि: आ-लम्बि, इस्, m., N. of a pupil of Vaiśampāyana.
आलम्बित: आ-लम्बित, अस्, आ, अम्, pendent, suspended, hang-ing from or on; supported, upheld; protected.
आलम्बिन्: आ-लम्बिन्, ई, इनी, इ, hanging from, resting or leaning upon; depending on or from; laying hold of, supporting, maintaining; wearing; (इनस्), m. pl. N. of a school.
आलम्ब्य: आ-लम्ब्य, ind. having supported; supporting, sustaining; taking by the hand.
आलय: आ-लय, अस्, अम्, m. n. a house, a dwelling, a re-ceptacle, an asylum; (frequently at the end of a com-pound, e. g. हिमालय, the abode of snow.)
आलर्क: आलर्क आलर्क, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अलर्क), caused by or relating to a mad dog.
आलवण्य: आलवण्य आलवण्य, अम्, n. (fr. अ-लवण), ugliness, insipidity.
आलवाल: आलवाल आलवाल, अम्, n. a basin for water round the root of a tree. See अलवाल, आवाल।
आलस: आलस आलस, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अ-लस), idle, slothful, lazy.
आलस्य: आलस्य, अस्, ई, अम्, idle, slothful, apathetic; (अम्), n. idleness, sloth, want of energy. —आलस्य-निबन्-धन, अस्, आ, अम्, originating in indolence.
आलाट्य: आलाट्य आलाट्य, अस्, आ, अम्, (rt. लट् for रट्), Ved. being amongst the breakers of the sea (?).
आलात: आलात आलात, अम्, n. a firebrand; a coal burning or extinguished. See अलात।

आलानिक: आलानिक, अस्, आ, अम्, serving as a post to which an elephant is tied.
आलाबु: आलाबु आलाबु, उस्, or आलाबू, ऊस्, f. a pump-kin gourd. See अ-लाबु।

आलिन्: आलिन्, ई, m. a scorpion [cf. अलिन्].

आली 2. आ-ली, cl. 4. A. -लीयते, -लेतुम् or -लातुम्, to settle down upon; to melt; faint.
आलिख्: आलिख् आ-लिख्, cl. 6. P. -लिखति, -लेखितुम्, to write, delineate.

आलेखन: आ-लेखन, अस्, आ, अम्, scratching, painting; (अस्), m., N. of a teacher; (ई), f. a brush, a pencil; (अम्), n. scratching, writing, painting.

आलिगी: आलिगी आलिगी, f., Ved., N. of a serpent.
आलिङ्ग्: आलिङ्ग् आ-लिङ्ग्, cl. 1. P. A. -लिङ्गति, -ते, गितुम्, or cl. 10. P. -लिङ्गयति, -यितुम्, to clasp, join the limbs closely; to encircle, embrace.
आलिङ्ग: आ-लिङ्ग, अस्, m. embracing; a kind of drum.
आलिङ्गन: आ-लिङ्गन, अम्, n. clasping, embracing, an em-brace.

आलिङ्ग्य: 1. आ-लिङ्ग्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be embraced; (अस्), m. a small drum.
आलिञ्जर: आलिञ्जर आलिञ्जर, अस्, m. a large clay water-jar.
आलिन्द: आलिन्द आलिन्द or आलिन्दक, अस्, m. a terrace before a house, a raised place or terrace for sleeping upon. See अलिन्द।
आलिप्: आलिप् आ-लिप्, cl. 6. P. -लिम्पति, -लेप्तुम्, to anoint, besmear.
आलिप्त: आ-लिप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, anointed, smeared, plastered.
आलिम्पन: आ-लिम्पन, अम्, n. whitening or painting the floor, wall, &c., on festival occasions.
आलेप: आ-लेप, अस्, m. smearing, plastering, anointing; liniment.
आलेपन: आ-लेपन, अम्, n. smearing, plastering; liniment.
आलीन: आ-लीन, अस्, आ, अम्, melted, fused.
आलीनक: आलीनक, अम्, n. tin; lead (from its melting easily).
आलीढ: आलीढ आ-लीढ, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. लिह्), eaten, licked, lapped by the tongue, scraped; (अस्), m., N. of a man; (अम्), n. an attitude in shooting, the right knee advanced, the left leg retracted.
आलीढक: आलीढक आलीढक, अम्, n. the frolicking of a calf; (etym. doubtful, perhaps for आढीलक।)

आलुञ्चन: आलुञ्चन आ-लुञ्चन, अम्, n. (rt. लुञ्च्), tear-ing in pieces, rending.
आलुड्: आलुड् आ-लुड्, cl. 1. P. -लोडति, -लोडितुम्, to stir up, mix, agitate.

आलोडित: आ-लोडित, अस्, आ, अम्, mixed, blended, shaken, agitated.
आलून: आलून आ-लून, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. लू), cut, cut off.

आलोकन: आ-लोकन, अम्, n. seeing, looking, sight, beholding.
आलोकनीय: आ-लोकनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, visible; to be considered, regarded. —आलोकनीय-ता, f. the being visible.
आलोकित: आ-लोकित, अस्, आ, अम्, seen, beheld.
आलोकिन्: आ-लोकिन्, ई, इनी, इ, seeing, beholding.
आलोक्य: आ-लोक्य, ind. having seen or looked at, beholding.
आलोच्: आलोच् आ-लोच्, cl. 1. A. -लोचते, -चितुम्, to behold, view, perceive, consider, reflect.
आलोचक: आ-लोचक, अस्, आ, अम्, beholding; causing to see; (अम्), n. the faculty of vision or the cause of sight.
आलोचन: आ-लोचन, अम्, आ, n. f. seeing, perceiving; con-sidering, reflecting.
आलोचित: आ-लोचित, अस्, आ, अम्, seen, beheld, considered.
आलोच्य: 1. आ-लोच्य or आ-लोचनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be seen, thought of or considered.

आलोल: आलोल आ-लोल, अस्, आ, अम्, trembling slightly, rolling (as an eye); shaken, agitated; (अस्), m. trem-bling, agitation.
आलोलित: आ-लोलित, अस्, आ, अम्, shaken, agitated.

आवच्: आवच् आ-वच्, cl. 3. P., Ved. -विवक्ति, -वक्-तुम्, to invoke.
आवत्: आवत् आ-वत्, त्, f. (fr. 3. आ), Ved. proximity, (opposed to परा-वत्।)
आवद्: आवद् आ-वद्, cl. 1. P., Ved. -वदति, -दितुम्, to shout at, invoke, celebrate.
आवनेय: आवनेय आवनेय, अस्, m. (fr. अवनि), son of the earth; epithet of the planet Mars.
आवन्तिक: आवन्तिक आवन्तिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अवन्ति), coming from or belonging to Avanti or the district of Oujein; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a Buddhist school; (आ), f., N. of the daughter of a Brāhman.
आवन्त्य: आवन्त्य, अस्, आ, अम्, coming from or being in the country Avanti; (अस्), m. a prince or an inhabitant of Avanti or of Oujein; the offspring of a degraded Brāhman.
आवप्: आवप् आ-वप्, cl. 1. P. A. -वपति, -ते, -वप्-तुम्, to sow, scatter; to pour out; to offer: Caus. P. -वापयति, -यितुम्, to shave, cut off, trim.

आवपन्तिक: आ-वपन्तिक, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. scattering.

आवापक: आवापक, अस्, m. a bracelet of gold, &c.
आवापन: आ-वापन, अम्, n. a loom, an implement for weaving; a reel or frame for winding thread.
आवापिक: आवापिक, अस्, आ, अम्, additional, inserted, supple-mentary.
आवय: आवय 1. आवय, अम्, n. (fr. 2. अ-वी), Ved. non-conception, barrenness.

आवयाज्: आवयाज् आवयाज्, स्, m. (fr. अव-याज्), Ved. one who expiates or averts by means of sacrifice; (Sāy. as if from rt. वी with आ) one who causes the sacrifice to go to the gods.
आवरसमक: आवरसमक आवरसमक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अवर-सम), to be paid in the following year.
आवर्जित: आ-वर्जित, अस्, आ, अम्, inclined, poured down, made to flow downwards.
