आशंसु: आ-शंसु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing, hoping, desiring.
आशस्: आ-शस्, अस्, f., Ved. wish, desire, hope; (Say.) praise.
आशा: 1. आ-शा, f. wish, desire, hope, expectation, pros-pect; hope personified as the wife of a Vasu: (for 2. आशा see next page.) —आशा-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, lit. ‘made expectation,’ attended with the expectation (of being gratified) or hope of success. —आशान्वित (°शा-अन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, having hope. —आशा-पिशाचिका, f. fallacious hopes. —आशा-प्राप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, success-ful, possessing the object hoped for. —आशा-बन्ध, अस्, m. band of hope, confidence, trust, expectation; a spider's web. —आशा-भङ्ग, अस्, m. disappointment. —आशा-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, hoping, having hope, trust-ing. —आशा-वह, अस्, m. bringing hope; N. of a son of heaven; of a Vṛṣṇi. —आशा-विभिन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, disappointed in expectation. —आशा-हीन, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has lost all hope, desponding, despairing.

आशा 2. आशा, f. (fr. rt. 1. अश्; for 1. आ-शा see last page under आ-शंस्), space, region, quarter of the compass, an intermediate region. —आशा-गज, अस्, m. an elephant of a quarter or point of the compass, sup-porting one division of the globe. —आशा-दामन्, आ, m., N. of a king. —आशादित्य (°शा-आद्°) or आशार्क (°शा-अर्°), अस्, m., N. of a commentator. —आशा-पाल, अस्, m., Ved. a defender or guardian of the regions or quarters. —आशा-पुर, आम्, n., N. of a town. —आशा-पुर-गुग्गुलु, उस्, or आशापुर-सम्भव, अस्, m. a kind of Bdellium.
आशक्: आशक् आ-शक्, cl. 5. P., Ved. -शक्नोति, -शक्-तुम्, to render one capable, to make one master or possessor of: Desid. Ved. -शिक्षति, to render one master of, impart.
आशक्त: आ-शक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, able, powerful, capable.
आशक्ति: आ-शक्ति, इस्, f. power, ability, might.
आशिक्षा: आ-शिक्षा, f., Ved. desire of learning.
आशङ्क्: आशङ्क् आ-शङ्क्, cl. 1. A. -शङ्कते, -कितुम्, to fear, suspect, doubt, hesitate.
आशङ्कनीय: आ-शङ्कनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be doubted; to be apprehended; questionable.
आशङ्कमान: आ-शङ्कमान, अस्, आ, अम्, fearing, apprehending.
आशङ्का: आ-शङ्का, f. fear, apprehension; doubt, uncertainty; distrust, suspicion. —आशङ्कान्वित (°का-अन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, apprehensive, doubting, uncertain; afraid.
आशङ्कित: आ-शङ्कित, अस्, आ, अम्, feared, dreaded; doubted.
आशङ्किन्: आ-शङ्किन्, ई, इनी, इ, fearing, doubting, hesitating.
आशङ्क्य: आ-शङ्क्य, ind. having suspected, fearing, appre-hending, doubting.
आशद्: आशद् आ-शद्, cl. 6. A. -शीयते, -शत्तुम्, to go.
आशन: आशन आशन, अस्, m., N. of the tree Pentaptera Tomentosa. See 3. अशन।
आशय: आ-शय, अस्, m. bed-chamber, resting-place, seat, place, an asylum, an abode or retreat; a receptacle; any recipient, any vessel or viscus of the body (e. g. रक्ताशय, the heart; आमाशय, the stomach, &c.); the stomach in particular; the seat of feelings and thoughts, the mind, heart; the thought lying in the mind, meaning, intention; disposition of mind, mode of thinking; will or pleasure; virtue, vice; fate, for-tune; property, possessions; a miser, a niggard; N. of the plant Artocarpus Integrifolia. —आशयाश (°य-आश), अस्, m. fire; [cf. आश्रयाश under 1. आ-श्रि।]
आशयाश: आशयाश आशयाश। See under आ-शय below.
आशर: आशर आ-शर, अस्, m. (rt. शॄ), fire; a Rakṣas, a goblin; the wind ? [cf. 1. आशिर].
आशरीक: आ-शरीक, अस्, m., Ved., N. of a disease, violent and acute pain in the limbs.
आशल: आशल आशल, अस्, m. a tree. See जीवक।
आशव: आशव आशव, अम्, n. (fr. आशु), speed, quick-ness; (for आ-सव, q. v.) a spirit distilled from molasses.
आशसन: आशसन आ-शसन, अम्, n. (rt. शस्), Ved. cutting up an animal when killed.
आशाढ: आशाढ आशाढ for आषाढ, q. v.
आशार: आशार आ-शार, अस्, m. (fr. rt. श्रि with आ), shelter. —आशारैषिन् (°र-एष्°), ई, इणी, इ, Ved. seek-ing shelter.
आशास्: आशास् आ-शास्, cl. 2. P. -शास्ति, -शासितुम्, to order, command, relate; A. -शास्ते, to wish well towards, pray for; to praise; to desire.
आशास्य: आ-शास्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be wished, desirable; (अम्), n. wish, benediction.
आशिस्: 1. आ-शिस्, ईस्, f. asking for, prayer, wish; blessing, benediction; bestowing or praying for a blessing upon others; one of the eight chief medicaments. —आशिर्-वाद or आशीर्-वाद, अस्, m. expression of a prayer or wish, benediction. —आशीर्-गेय, अम्, n. a song ac-companied with benedictions. —आशीर्-दा, f., Ved. the offering of a prayer. —आशीर्-वचन, अम्, n. a bless-ing, a benediction.
आशिस् 2. आशिस्, ईस्, f. (fr. rt. 1. अश्), a ser-pent's fang: (for 1. आ-शिस् see above.) —आशिर्-विष, अस्, m. a snake (having venom in its fang).
आशी: 1. आ-शी, f. wishing or bestowing a blessing.
2. आशी, f. a serpent's fang; a kind of venom, the venom of a snake. —आशी-विष, see आशिर्-विष।
आशी 3. आ-शी, cl. 2. A. -शेते, -शयितुम्, to lie or sleep on, pass (the night) in sleep; to inhabit, have for one's home.
आशिञ्जित: आशिञ्जित आ-शिञ्जित, अस्, आ, अम्, tinkling (as of the ornaments worn on the hands and feet).
आशिन: आशिन आशिन, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. 1. अश्), Ved. aged; (reaching to many years.)
आशिमन्: आशिमन् आशिमन्। See under आशु next col.
आशिमन्, आ, m. quickness, rapidity; = आशव, q. v.
आशिर्: आशिर् आशिर्, ईस्, f. (fr. rt. शॄ for श्री with आ), Ved. the milk which is mixed with the Soma juice to purify it (e. g. दध्याशिरः सोमासः = Soma offer-ings purified by mixture with thickened milk). —आशीर्-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. mixed with milk (as Soma).
आशिरःपादम्: आशिरःपादम् आ-शिरः-पादम्, ind. from head to foot.
आशु: आशु आशु, उस्, उस्, उ (said to be fr. 1. अश्), fast, quick, going quickly; (उ), ind. quickly, quick, immediately, directly; (उस्), m., Ved. the quick one, a horse; (उस् or उ), m. n. rice ripening quickly in the rainy season; [cf. Gr. ὠκύς, ὤκιστος Lat. acu in acupedeus, ôcissimus: of the same origin may be the Lat. aquila and accipiter.] —आशु-कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, doing anything quickly, smart, active; (in medic.) operating speedily. —आशु-कोपिन्, ई, इनी, इ, easily pro-voked, irritable. —आशु-क्रिया, f. quick procedure. —आशु-ग, अस्, आ, अम्, going or moving quickly, swift, fleet; (अस्), m. the wind; the sun; an arrow; N. of one of the first five followers of Śākya-muni. —आशु-गामिन्, ई, इनी, इ, going or moving quickly; (ई), m. an epithet of the sun. —आशुङ्-ग, अस्, m., Ved. N. of an animal, perhaps a bird; going to the horse (?). —आशु-तोष, अस्, आ, अम्, easily pleased or appeased; (अस्), m., N. of Śiva. —आशु-त्व, अम्, n. quickness. —आशु-पत्त्री, f. a tree which yields frankincense, Boswellia Serrata. —आशु-पत्वन्, आ, m., Ved. flying quickly. —आशु-फल, अस्, m. a kind of weapon. —आशु-बोध, ‘easily understood,’ ‘teaching quickly,’ title of a grammar. —आशु-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. quick; (अत्), ind. quickly. —१। आशु-या, आस्, आस्, अम्, Ved. (Sāy.) going quickly. —आशु-रथ, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. pos-sessing a fast chariot. —आशु-व्रीहि, इस्, m. rice ripen-ing quickly in the rainy season. —आशु-षेण, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having swift arrows. —आशु-हेमन्, आ, m., Ved. urged to fast course, running on quickly; inciting his horses (as an epithet of Agni, especially when regarded as Apāṃ-napāt). —आशु-हेषस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. having neighing horses; (Sāy.) having quick horses or quickly praised; epithet of the Aśvins. —आश्व्-अपस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. acting quickly. —आश्व्-अश्व, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. possessed of quick horses; an epithet of the Maruts. —आश्वश्व्य, अम्, n., Ved. possession of quick horses.
आशुशुक्षणि: आशुशुक्षणि आ-शुशुक्षणि, इस्, इस्, इ (fr. rt. शुच् with आ), Ved. shining forth; (Sāy.) ‘being worshipped on account of shining very quickly’ or ‘causing sorrow (to one's enemies’); (इस्), m. fire, wind; air.
आशेकुटिन्: आशेकुटिन् आशेकुटिन्, ई, m. a mountain (etymology doubtful).
आशोषण: आशोषण आ-शोषण, अम्, n. the act of drying.
आशौच: आशौच आशौच, अम्, n. (fr. अ-शुचि), impurity.
आश्चर्य: आश्चर्य 1. आश्चर्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. चर् with आ, with a sibilant inserted), appearing rarely, curious, marvellous, astonishing, wonderful, extraordinary; (अम्), ind. rarely, wonderfully; (अम्), n. strange ap-pearance; a wonder, miracle, marvel, prodigy; won-der, surprise; astonishment. —आश्चर्य-ता, f. or आश्-चर्य-त्व, अम्, n. wonderfulness, wonder, astonish-ment. —आश्चर्य-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, having a mar-vellous appearance, wonderful. —आश्चर्य-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, wonderful, marvellous, miraculous.
2. आश्चर्य, nom. P. (?) -यति, -यितुम्, to be won-derful.
आश्चोतन: आश्चोतन आ-श्चोतन or आ-श्च्योतन, अम्, n. (fr. rt. श्चुत् or श्च्युत् with आ), aspersion, sprinkling; applying ghee &c. to the eyelids.
आश्म: आश्म आश्म, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अश्मन्), stony, made of stone. —आश्मभारिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अश्म-भार), having a mass of stones. —आश्मरथ्य, अस्, m., N. of a teacher of ritual.
आश्मन: आश्मन, अस्, ई, अम्, stony, made of stone; (अस्), m., N. of Aruṇa, the charioteer of the sun.
आश्मरिक: आश्मरिक, अस्, ई, अम्, suffering from stone in the bladder.
आश्मिक: आश्मिक, अस्, ई, अम्, made of stone, consisting of stone, &c.
आश्यै: आश्यै आ-श्यै, cl. 1. A. -श्यायते, -श्यातुम्, to become coagulated or congealed, to congeal, to become dry.
आश्यान: 1. आ-श्यान, अस्, आ, अम्, consolidated, coagulated, congealed.
2. आ-श्यान, अस्, आ, अम् (आ implying diminution), partially dried.
आश्रपण: आश्रपण आ-श्रपण, अम्, n. (rt. श्री with आ), the act of cooking slightly.
आश्रम: आश्रम आ-श्रम, अस्, अम्, m. n. (fr. rt. श्रम् with आ), a hermitage, the abode of ascetics, the cell of a hermit or of retired saints or sages; a period in the religious life of a Brāhman, of which there are four referable to the different periods of life (viz. 1st, that of the Brahma-cārin or student; 2nd, that of the Gṛha-stha or householder; 3rd, that of the Vāna-prastha or anchorite; and 4th, that of the Bhikṣu or beggar: in some places the law-givers mention only three such periods of religious life, the first period being then omitted); a college, a school; a wood or thicket. —आश्रम-गुरु, उस्, m. the head of a re-ligious order, a preceptor, a principal. —आश्रम-धर्म, अस्, m. the special duty or duties of each order or period of life. —आश्रम-पद, अम्, n. a hermitage; a period in the religious life of a Brāhman. —आश्रम-पर्वन्, अ, n. the first section of the fif-teenth book of the Mahā-bhārata. —आश्रम-भ्र-ष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, fallen or apostatising from an आश्रम or religious order. —आश्रम-मण्डल, अम्, n. the circle of a hermitage, a hermitage. —आश्रमवासिक, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to residence in a hermitage; आश्रमवासिकम् पर्व, title of the fifteenth book of the Mahā-bhārata. —आश्रम-वासिन्, ई, or आश्रम-सद्, त्, m. an inhabitant of a hermitage, an ascetic. —आश्रम-स्थान, अम्, n. the abode of hermits, a hermitage. —आश्रमालय (°म-आल्°), अस्, m. an in-habitant of a hermitage, an ascetic. —आश्रमोपनि-षद् (°म-उप्°), त्, f. title of an Upaniṣad.
आश्रमिक: आश्रमिक, अस्, ई, अम्, or आश्रमिन्, ई, इणी, इ, belonging to one of the four orders or periods of religious life; belonging to a hermitage, a hermit, an anchorite, &c.
आश्रव: आश्रव 1. आ-श्रव, अस्, m. (more correctly written आ-स्रव, q. v.), stream, flow, river; distress, fatigue; fault, transgression. (For 2. आ-श्रव see under आ-श्रु next page.)
2. आ-श्रव, अस्, आ, अम्, obedient, compliant; (अस्), m. a promise, an engagement. (For 1. आ-श्रव see last page.)
आश्रि: आश्रि 1. आ-श्रि, cl. 1. P. A. -श्रयति, -ते, -यितुम्, to resort to, betake one's self to; seek refuge in, enter, inhabit; depend on, choose, prefer; to assist, adhere to, be subject to, keep in mind.
आश्रि 2. आश्रि, इस्, f. the edge of a sword. See अश्रि।
आश्रय: आ-श्रय, अस्, m. that to which anything is annexed, or with which anything is closely connected, or on which anything depends or rests; a recipient, the per-son or thing in which any quality or article is inherent or retained or received; seat, resting-place; dwelling, asylum, place of refuge, shelter; depending on, having recourse to; help, assistance, protection; authority, sanction, warrant; a plea, an excuse; being inclined or addicted to, following, practising; attaching to, choosing, taking; joining, union, attachment; de-pendance, contiguity, vicinity; relation; connection; appropriate act or one consistent with the character of the agent; (in gram.) the subject, that to which the predicate is annexed; (with Buddhists) the five organs of sense with मनस् or mind (the six together being the recipients of the आश्रित or objects which enter them by way of their आलम्बन or qualities); source, origin. आश्रय may occur at the end of compounds in the sense of ‘depending on, resting on, endowed or furnished with’ (e. g. अष्ट-गुणाश्रय, see under अष्ट). —आश्रय-तस्, ind. in consequence of the proximity. —आश्रय-त्व, अम्, n. the state of आ-श्रय above. —आश्रय-भुज्, क्, m. fire; see आश्रयाश। —आश्रय-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, one who is the refuge or support of another person, protecting, supporting. —आश्रय-लिङ्ग, अस्, आ, अम्, a word the gender of which must agree with the gender of the word to which it is referred, an adjective. —आश्रय-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having help or support. —आश्रयाश (°य-आश), अस्, आ, अम्, consuming everything with which (it) comes in contact; (अस्), m. fire; a forfeiter of an asylum, one who by misconduct &c. loses patronage or protection.
आश्रयण: आ-श्रयण, अस्, ई, अम्, resorting to, seeking refuge in; relating to; (अम्), n. betaking one's self to; joining, accepting, choosing; refuge, asylum, means of protection or security.
आश्रयणीय: आ-श्रयणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be had recourse to, to be practised or followed.
आश्रित: आ-श्रित, अस्, आ, अम्, inhabiting, dwelling in, resort-ing to as a retreat or asylum; having recourse to; following, practising, observing; using, employing; receiving anything as an inherent or integral part; taking one's station at a window or seat &c.; depend-ant on, a dependant; (आनि), n. pl. the objects perceived by the senses and मनस् or mind. —आश्रित-त्व, अम्, n. dependance.
आश्रित्य: आ-श्रित्य, ind. having sought or obtained an asylum; having recourse to, employing, practising.
आश्रु: आश्रु आ-श्रु, cl. 5. P. -शृणोति, -श्रोतुम्, to listen to, to hear; to accept, promise: Caus. -श्राव-यति, -यितुम्, to cause to hear, to call, to tell: Desid. -शुश्रूषति, to wish to hear; to listen.
आश्रावण: आ-श्रावण, अम्, n. calling out so as to make one listen; designation of certain short words uttered at ceremonies.
आश्राव्य: आ-श्राव्य, अस्, m., N. of a man.
आश्रुत: आ-श्रुत, अस्, आ, अम्, heard, promised, agreed; (अम्), n. calling so as to make one listen.
आश्रुति: आ-श्रुति, इस्, f., Ved. hearing; range of hearing.
आश्रुत्कर्ण: आश्रुत्-कर्ण, अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. one whose ears listen all around.
आश्लिष्: आश्लिष् आ-श्लिष्, cl. 4. P. A. -श्लिष्यति, -ते, -श्लेष्टुम्, to embrace.
आश्रेष: आ-श्रेष, अस्, m. (for आ-श्लेष), Ved. one who embraces; N. of an evil spirit or goblin; (आस्), f. pl., N. of the seventh Nakṣatra or lunar mansion.
आश्लिष्ट: आ-श्लिष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, embraced; embracing, who or what embraces; connected, interwoven, blended; attaching to, joining, who or what adheres to; in-vested, spread; connected as a consequence, deduced, concluded.
आश्लेष: आ-श्लेष, अस्, m. embracing, embrace, intwining; intimate connection, contact; site of any act; (आस्), f. pl., N. of the seventh Nakṣatra.
आश्व: आश्व आश्व, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अश्व), relating or belonging to a horse, equestrian, coming from a horse (e. g. आश्वम् मूत्रम्, ‘the urine of a horse’); drawn by horses (e. g. आश्वो रथः, ‘a chariot drawn by horses’); (अम्), n. a number of horses, a chariot drawn by horses; the state or action of a horse. —आश्व-घ्न, अस्, m., Ved., N. of a man.
आश्वतर: आश्वतर, अस्, m. (fr. अश्व-तर), patronymic of Buḍila (Bulila); a descendant of Aśvatara, son of Aśva.
आश्वत्थ: आश्वत्थ, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अश्वत्थ), taken from or made of the tree Ficus Religiosa; relating to the fruit-bearing season of this tree; (अम्), n. the fruit of the holy fig tree.
आश्वत्थिक: आश्वत्थिक, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to or produced by the Aśvattha tree; relating to its fruit-bearing season.
आश्वपेजिन्: आश्वपेजिन्, इनस्, m. pl. (fr. अश्व-पेज), the pupils or followers of Aśva-peja.
आश्वबल: आश्वबल, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अश्व-बला), produced by the plant Aśva-balā.
आश्वबाल: आश्वबाल or आश्ववाल, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अश्व-बाल), made of the cane Aśva-bāla.
आश्वमेधिक: आश्वमेधिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अश्व-मेध), be-longing to the horse-sacrifice; (आश्वमेधिकम् पर्व is the N. of the fourteenth book of the Mahā-bhārata.)
आश्वयुज: आश्वयुज, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अश्व-युज्), born under the constellation Aśvayuj, belonging to or occurring in the month Āśvina; (अस्), m. the month Āśvina; (ई), f. the day of full moon in Āśvina.
आश्वयुजक: आश्वयुजक, अस्, ई, अम्, sown at the day of full moon in the month Āśvina.
आश्वरथ: आश्वरथ, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अश्व-रथ), belonging to a chariot drawn by horses.
आश्वलक्षणिक: आश्वलक्षणिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अश्व-लक्षण), knowing the marks of horses; (अस्), m. a farrier, a groom.
आश्वायन: आश्वायन, अस्, m. (fr. अश्व + अयन), a descendant of Aśva.
आश्विक: आश्विक, अस्, ई, अम्, equestrian, cavalier, relating to a horse, drawn by horses.
आश्विन: आश्विन, अस्, ई, अम्, (if fr. 1. अश्विन्) Ved. like riders; belonging to or devoted to the Aśvins; (if fr. rt. 1. अश्, to pervade), pervading, penetrating; (अस्), m., N. of a month of the rainy season, during which the moon is near to the constellation Aśvinī; (ई), f., N. of certain (इष्टका), bricks; (अम्), n. a day's journey for a horse or rider.
आश्विनेय: आश्विनेय, अस्, m. (a patronymic fr. अश्विनौ, the fathers of the twins Nakula and Sahadeva), N. of Sahadeva, the youngest of the Pāṇḍava princes; (fr. their mother अश्विनी), an epithet of either of the two Aśvins.
आश्वीन: आश्वीन, अस्, ई, अम्, passed over by a horse in one day; (अम्), n. a day's journey for a horse.
आश्वीय: आश्वीय, अम्, n. a number of horses.
आश्वेय: आश्वेय, अस्, m. a patronymic from Aśva.
आश्वलायन: आश्वलायन आश्वलायन, अस्, m. (patronymic fr. अश्वल), N. of the author of a ritual work, called the Āśvalāyana Sūtras; he was a disciple of Śaunaka; (अस्, ई, अम्), belonging to Āśvalāyana.
आश्वस्: आश्वस् आ-श्वस्, cl. 2. P. -श्वसिति, -सितुम्, to breathe, breathe again, breathe freely, take breath, recover breath, take heart or courage; to revive: Caus. P. -श्वासयति, -यितुम्, to cause one to take breath; to encourage, comfort, cheer up; to con-ciliate.
आश्वसत्: आ-श्वसत्, अन्, अती, अत्, taking breath, breathing anew; reviving; recovering.
आश्वसित: आ-श्वसित, अस्, आ, अम्, encouraged, cheered, con-soled.
आश्वास: आ-श्वास, अस्, m. breathing again, taking breath, breathing freely, recovery; cheering up, consolation; a chapter or section, the division of a book; a pro-bable story; cessation, completion.
आश्वासक: आ-श्वासक, अस्, इका, अम्, consolatory, consoling, comforting; (अस्), m. clothing.
आश्वासन: आ-श्वासन, अम्, n. making or letting one take breath, consoling, encouraging, reviving; cheering up.
आश्वासयत्: आ-श्वासयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, encouraging, animating.
आश्वासित: आ-श्वासित, अस्, आ, अम्, encouraged, animated, com-forted, consoled.
आश्वासिन्: आ-श्वासिन्, ई, इनी, इ, breathing freely, reviving, be-coming cheerful; consoling.
आश्वास्य: आ-श्वास्य, ind. having consoled, having cherished; having recovered or revived.
आषाढ: आषाढ आषाढ, अस्, m. (fr. अ-षाढा), N. of a month, corresponding to part of June and July, in which the full moon is near the constellation Aṣāḍhā; a staff of the wood of the Palāśa, carried by an ascetic during certain vows in the month Āṣāḍha; N. of a prince; the Malaya mountain; (आ), f. the twenty-first and twenty-second lunar mansions, commonly compounded with पूर्व and उत्तर; (ई), f. the day of full moon in the month Āṣāḍha. —आषाढ-भव, अस्, आ, अम्, produced in the month Āṣāḍha; (अस्), m. the planet Mars. —आषाढ-भूति, इस्, m., N. of a man. —आषाढा-भू, ऊस्, m. produced in the month Āṣāḍha; the planet Mars.
आषाढक: आषाढक, अस्, m. the month Āṣāḍha; N. of a man.
आषाढिका: आषाढिका, f., N. of a Rākṣasī.
आषाढीय: आषाढीय, अस्, आ, अम्, born under the constella-tion Aṣāḍhā.
आष्टक: आष्टक आष्टक, N. of a region.
आष्टम: आष्टम आष्टम, अस्, m. (fr. अष्टम), the eighth part.
आष्ट्र: आष्ट्र आष्ट्र, अम्, n. (fr. rt. 1. अश्), ether, sky, atmosphere.
आष्ट्री: आष्ट्री आष्ट्री, f., Ved. kitchen, fire-place; (if fr. rt. 1. अश्, according to Sāy.) an extensive forest.
आष्ठा: आष्ठा आष्ठा, f. [cf. 2. आशा], region, quarter.
आस्: आस् 1. आस्, ind. (an interjection implying joy, anger, menace, pain, affliction, recollection) Ah! Oh! &c.
आस् 2. आस् (आ-अस्), cl. 4. P., Ved. आस्यति, सितुम्, to enclose, border; to admit (as water) into.

3. आस् (fr. 2. आस् above ? or fr. rt. 2. अस्; cf. Lat. os), mouth, face; only used in two forms, as follows: आसस्, abl., Ved. from mouth to mouth, in close proximity; आसा, inst., Ved. before one's eyes; by word of mouth, personally; present; in one's own person; immedi-ately. —आस्-पात्र, अम्, n., Ved. a vessel which is as it were the mouth of the gods.

आस् 4. आस्, cl. 2. A. आस्ते (Ved. and poet. also cl. 1. A. आसते), आसाञ्-चक्रे, आसिष्यते, -आसिष्ट, -सितुम्, to sit, sit down, rest, lie; to be present, to exist, to inhabit, dwell in; to make one's abode in; to sit quietly, abide, remain, continue; to cease, have an end; to solemnize, celebrate; to do anything without interruption, to continue doing any-thing, to continue in any situation, to last. It is used in the sense of ‘continuing,’ with a participle, adj., or subst. (e. g. एतत् साम गायन्न् आस्ते, ‘he continues singing this verse’); with an indeclinable participle in त्वा, य, or अम् (e. g. उपरुध्य अरिम् आसीत, ‘he should continue blockading the foe’); with an adverb (e. g. तूष्णीम् आस्ते, ‘he continues quiet;’ सुखम् आस्व, ‘continue well’); with an inst. case (e. g. सुखेन आस्ते, ‘he continues well’); with a dat. case (e. g. आस्तां तुष्टये, ‘may it be to your satisfac-tion’): Caus. आसयति, -यितुम्, to cause any one to sit down: Desid. आसिसिषते; [cf. Gr. ἧ(σ)-μαι, ἧσ-ται Lat. âsa changed to âra; â-nus for âs-nus.]
आस् 5. आस् (आ-आस्), cl. 2. P., Ved. आस्ते, -सि-तुम्, to sit down upon.
आस: 1. आस, seat (e. g. in the compound स्वास-स्थ, ‘staying in one's own seat’); (अम्), n. the seat or lower part of the body; proximity.
आस 2. आस, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 2. अस्, to throw), Ved. ashes, dust which easily flies away; (अस्, अम्), m. n. a bow. (For 1. आस see under 4. आस्।)
आसन: 1. आसन, अम्, n. sitting, sitting down; sitting in peculiar postures, according to the custom of devotees, (five or, in other places, even eighty-four postures are enumerated; see पद्मासन, भद्रासन, वज्रा-सन, वीरासन, स्वस्तिकासन: the manner of sitting forming part of the eight-fold observances of ascetics); halting, stopping, encamping; abiding, dwelling; seat, place, stool; the withers of an ele-phant, the part where the driver sits; maintaining a post against an enemy; (आ), f. stay, abiding; (ई), f. stay, abiding, sitting; a shop, a stall; a small seat, a stool.
2. आसन, अम्, n. throwing; (अस्), m., N. of a tree. See असन।
आसन आसन, See under 4. आस् and 2. आस।
आसित: आसित, अस्, आ, अम्, seated, at rest, one who has sat down, one who is seated or dwells; (अम्), n. sitting, sitting down; a seat; place where one has lived, place of abode, a city; दुर्-आसितम्, an improper way of sitting.
आसीन: आसीन, अस्, आ, अम्, sitting, seated. —आसीन-प्रच-लायित, अम्, n. nodding, nodding when seated, falling asleep.
आस्या: आस्या, f. sitting, abiding, abode, state of rest.
आस्या आस्या, f. See under 4. आस्।
आसंसार: आसंसार आ-संसार, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. सृ), liable to continuous flow, progress or alteration; (अम्), ind. as long as the world goes on, till the end of the world.
आसङ्गत्य: आसङ्गत्य आसङ्गत्य, अम्, n. (fr. अ-सङ्गत), detachment, disunion.
आसञ्ज्: आसञ्ज् आ-सञ्ज्, cl. 1. P. -सजति, -सङ्क्तुम्, to fasten on, attach, fix; to fasten on one's self, put on (as dress, armour, &c.); to take up: Caus. -सञ्ज-यति, -यितुम्, to cause to attach, have (anything) fastened or put on: Pass. -सज्यते, to adhere, cohere, to be attached.
आसक्त: आ-सक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, attached strongly to or intent on; zealously following or pursuing; trusting to, confiding in, eternal; (अम्), ind. eternally. —आसक्त-चित्त, अस्, आ, अम्, having the mind deeply engaged in, intent on, devoted to, absorbed in. —आसक्त-चेतस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, having the mind fixed or intent on any object. —आसक्त-मनस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, having the mind fixed upon any object.
आसक्ति: आ-सक्ति, इस्, f. devotedness or attachment (as to one object or pursuit), diligence, application; Ved. lying wait for, way-laying; (इ), ind., Ved. purposely, intentionally.
आसङ्ग: आ-सङ्ग, अस्, m. fastening to, fixing; association, connection; attachment to any object; proximity, contact; Ved. way-laying; N. of a man; (अम्), n. a kind of fragrant earth; (अस्, आ, अम्), uninterrupted, eternal; (अम्), ind. without interruption; eternally.
आसङ्गिम: आसङ्गिम, अस्, m. (in surgery) a kind of bandage.
आसञ्जन: आ-सञ्जन, अम्, n., Ved. putting on (dress, armour, ornaments, &c.); fastening to, fixing; a handle, a hook. —आसञ्जन-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having a handle, hook, loop, &c.
आसद्: आसद् आ-सद्, cl. 1. P. -सीदति, -सत्तुम्, to sit down, sit near; to place; to approach, meet with, find; encounter, attack, commence, undertake; cl. 10. P. -सादयति, -यितुम्, to approach, meet with, find; encounter, attack; commence, undertake; Ved. to make one sit down.
आसत्ति: आ-सत्ति, इस्, f. intimate union, meeting, junction; gain, profit, acquirement; (in logic) connection or relation between two or more proximate terms and the sense they convey.
आसदन: आ-सदन, अम्, n. the act of sitting down; a seat.
आसन्न: आ-सन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, near, proximate; (अस्), m. the setting sun. —आसन्न-काल, अस्, m. the hour of death; one whose last hour is at hand. —आसन्न-तर, अस्, आ, अम्, nearer. —आसन्नतर-ता, f. greater nearness. —आसन्न-प्रसव, अस्, आ, अम्, near par-turition, about to bring forth or to lay eggs.
आसाद: आ-साद, अस्, m., Ved. a cushion.
आसादन: आ-सादन, अम्, n. putting or laying down; attack-ing, making war upon; going to or towards; meeting with; obtaining, attaining; accomplishing.
आसादयितव्य: आ-सादयितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be attacked, to be encountered; attainable.
आसादित: आ-सादित, अस्, आ, अम्, obtained, acquired, gained, reached, gone to; spread, extended, overspread; effected, completed; met with, attacked.
आसाद्य: 1. आ-साद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, attainable, obtainable.
2. आ-साद्य, ind. having attained or reached; hav-ing obtained, according to.
आसिसादयिषु: आ-सिसादयिषु, उस्, उस्, उ, about to attack; wishing to attack.
आसन्: आसन् आसन्, n. [cf. 2. आस् and आस्य], Ved. the mouth, the jaws; (this word occurs in inst., dat., abl., loc. sing., and inst. plur.) —आसन्न्-इषु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. one who has arrows in his mouth.
आसन्य: आसन्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. being in the mouth.
आसन्द: आसन्द आसन्द, अस्, m. (fr. rt. सद् with आ ?), an epithet of Viṣṇu; (ई), f. a small couch or oblong chair, the seat of which is made of basket work; a chair, arm-chair. —आसन्दी-वत्, आन्, m., N. of a country.
आसन्वत्: आसन्वत् आसन्वत्, आन्, अती, अत् (fr. rt. 1. अस्?), Ved. what exists or is present (?).
आसमुद्रात्: आसमुद्रात् आ-समुद्रात्, ind. as far as the ocean.
आसम्बाध: आसम्बाध आ-सम्बाध, अस्, आ, अम्, blocked up, obstructed, confined.
आसया: आसया आसया, ind. (irreg. inst. case fr. 3. आस्, q. v.), Ved. together with, from mouth to mouth, near to, in the presence of.
आसव: 1. आ-सव, अस्, m. distilling, distillation; decoction; rum, spirit distilled from sugar or molasses, spirituous liquor in general: (for 2. आ-सव see next col.) —आसव-द्रु, उस्, m., N. of the Palmyra tree, Bo-rassus Flabellifornis; (its juice on fermenting afford-ing a spirituous liquor.)
2. आ-सव, अस्, m., Ved. exciting, enlivening.
आसात्: आसात् आसात्, ind. (fr. 1. आस), Ved. from or in the proximity, near.
आसाधन: आसाधन आ-साधन, अम्, n. (rt. 1. सिध्), accomplishment, attainment.
आसिद्ध: 1. आ-सिद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, accomplished, effected. (For 2. आ-सिद्ध see below.)
आसिद्ध 2. आ-सिद्ध, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. 2. सिध्), put under restraint, imprisoned. (For 1. see above.)
आसार: आसार आ-सार, अस्, m. (rt. सृ), surrounding an enemy; incursion; attack; a hard shower; the army of an ally or of a king, whose dominions are separated by other intervening states; provision, food.
आसाव्य: आ-साव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be born.
आसिक: आसिक आसिक, अस्, m. (fr. असि), a swordsman.
आसिका: आसिका आसिका, f. (fr. rt. 4. आस्), turn or order of sitting; sitting; (अस्, आ, अम्), one who sits.
आसिच्: आसिच् 1. आ-सिच्, cl. 6. P. -सिञ्चति, -सेक्तुम्, to pour in or on, besprinkle, wet, water: Caus. -सेचयति, -यितुम्, to have (anything) poured in.
2. आ-सिच्, क्, f., Ved. a dish, vessel; (Say.) an oblation which is poured out.
आसिक्त: आ-सिक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, poured in or on; sprinkled.
आसेक: आ-सेक, अस्, m. wetting, sprinkling, pouring in.
आसेचन: आ-सेचन, अम्, n. the act of pouring into, wetting, sprinkling; Ved. a reservoir or vessel for fluids; (अस्, ई, अम्), charming, lovely, beloved [cf. अ-सेचन, for which it may be a substitute]. —आसेचन-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, containing a reservoir or cavity, hollow, concave.
आसेचनक: आसेचनक, अस्, आ, अम् (?), beloved, desired, charm-ing [cf. अ-सेचन].
आसेद्धृ: आ-सेद्धृ, धा, m. one who confines or arrests another.
आसेध: आ-सेध, अस्, m. arrest, custody, legal restraint of four kinds, viz. कालासेध, limitation of time; स्था-नासेध, confinement to a place; प्रवासासेध, prohibition against removal or departure; कर्मा-सेध, restriction from employment.
आसेध आ-सेध। See 2. आ-सिद्ध last col.
आसेधक: आ-सेधक, अस्, आ, अम्, restraining, confining.
आसेधनीय: आ-सेधनीय or आ-सेध्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be placed in custody, restrained, confined, prohibited, interrupted.
आसु: आसु 1. आ-सु, cl. 5. P., Ved. -सुनोति, -सोतुम्, to press out Soma juice, to distil.
आसु 2. आ-सु, cl. 2. P., Ved. -सौति, -सोतुम्, to bring forth, excite.
आसाव: आ-साव, अस्, m., Ved. one who presses out the Soma juice; (Sāy.) a praiser (?).
आसुति: 1. आ-सुति, इस्, f. distilling; decoction; a draught so prepared; distillation: (for 2. आ-सुति see next col.) —आसुती-वल, अस्, m. a sacrificing priest; a sacrificer at the full and change of the moon; one who pre-pares or sells spirituous liquors, a distiller; one who sells female slaves (?).
2. आ-सुति, इस्, f., Ved. exciting, enlivening.
आसवितृ: आ-सवितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, Ved. exciting, an exciter.
आसुर: आसुर आसुर, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. असुर), spiritual, divine; belonging to or devoted to evil spirits; be-longing or relating to the Asuras; infernal, demoni-acal; (अस्), m. an Asura or demon; a form of mar-riage in which the bridegroom purchases the bride from her father and paternal kinsmen; (आस्), m. pl. the stars of the southern hemisphere; a prince of the warrior-tribe Asura; (ई), f. a division of medicine, surgery, curing by cutting with instruments, applying the actual cautery; N. of the plant Sinapis Ramosa; (अम्), n. blood; black salt.
आसुर; under (ई), f. add — an epithet of बुद्धि in the Sāṅkhya philosophy.
आसुरायण: आसुरायण, अस्, m., N. of a teacher.
आसुरि: आसुरि, इस्, m. (patron. fr. असुर), N. of a teacher. —आसुरि-वासिन्, ई, m. an epithet of Prāśnīputra.
आसुरीय: आसुरीय, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging to or coming from Āsuri.
आसू: आसू आ-सू, cl. 6. P., Ved. -सुवति, -सवितुम्, to bring or send quickly, yield, grant.
आसूत्रित: आसूत्रित आ-सूत्रित, अस्, आ, अम्, tied on or round, forming or wearing a garland.
आसृज्: आसृज् आ-सृज्, cl. 6. P., Ved. -सृजति, -स्रष्-टुम्, to pour out upon, pour in.
आसेव्: आसेव् आ-सेव्, cl. 1. A. or poet. P. -सेवते, -ति, -वितुम्, to attend to, accomplish; carry out, practice, perform assiduously; to indulge in, enjoy.
आसेवन: आ-सेवन, अम्, n. assiduous practice or performance of any action.
आसेवा: आ-सेवा, f. zealous cultivation of any pursuit; com-merce, intercourse.
आसेविन्: आ-सेविन्, ई, इनी, इ, performing assiduously, acting.
आस्कन्द्: आस्कन्द् आ-स्कन्द्, cl. 1. P. -स्कन्दति, -स्कन्-तुम्, to invade, attack.
आस्कन्द: आ-स्कन्द, अस्, m. ascending, mounting; assault, attack; an assailant.
आस्कन्दन: आ-स्कन्दन, अम्, n. going towards, assailing, at-tack; battle, war; reproach, abuse; effacing, destroy-ing; drying (?).
आस्कन्दित: आ-स्कन्दित or आ-स्कन्दितक, अम्, n. the walk of an horse.
आस्कन्दिन्: आ-स्कन्दिन्, ई, इनी, इ, jumping upon, assailing; causing to flow; granting.
आस्कु: आस्कु आ-स्कु, cl. 5. P., Ved. -स्कुनोति, -स्को-तुम्, to snatch up.
आस्क्र: आस्क्र आ-स्क्र, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. स्कृ = rt. कृ?), Ved. joined, united; (Sāy.) attacking, assailing ene-mies, approaching.
आस्तर: आ-स्तर, अस्, m. a covering, coverlet, blanket thrown over the back of a horse or elephant; a carpet, bed; spreading (clothes &c.); N. of a man.
आस्ताव: आस्ताव आ-स्ताव, अस्, m. (rt. स्तु), Ved. the place of reciting a particular hymn.
आस्तिक: आस्तिक आस्तिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अस्ति, 3rd pers. sing. of rt. 1. अस्), a believer in sacred tradition; one who believes in God and another world; believing, pious, faithful; (अस्), m., N. of a Muni or saint, more correctly written आस्तीक, q. v. —आस्तिक-ता, f. or आस्तिक-त्व, अम्, n. belief in God.
आस्तिकार्थद: आस्तिकार्थद or आस्तीकार्थद (°क-अर्थ-द), अस्, m. an epithet of king Janam-ejaya (who granted the request of the sage Āstika, and spared the Nāga Takṣaka from the destruction to which he had doomed the serpent-race).
आस्तिक्य: आस्तिक्य, अम्, n. belief in God, piety, faithfulness, a believing nature or disposition.
आस्तीक: आस्तीक, अस्, m., N. of an old saint, the son of Jarat-kāru; (अस्, ई, अम्), relating to or treating of that saint; आस्तीकम् पर्व, a section of the first book of the Mahā-bhārata. —आस्तीक-जननी, f. the wife of Jarat-kāru and mother of Āstīka.
आस्तीक्य: आस्तीक्य, अम्, n. (? error for आस्तिक्य), belief.
आस्तृ: आस्तृ आ-स्तृ or आ-स्तॄ, cl. 5. 9. P. A. -स्तृ-णोति, -णुते, -णाति, -णीते, -स्तर्तुम्, -रितुम्, -रीतुम्, to spread (as a carpet &c.), deck, bestrew, scatter over, cover.
आस्तरण: आ-स्तरण, अम्, ई, n. f. the act of spreading; a carpet, a rug, a cushion, a quilt, bed-clothes; a bed; a layer of sacred grass spread out at a sacrifice; an elephant's housings, a painted cloth or blanket worn on his back. —आस्तरण-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, covered with a cloth or carpet.
आस्तरणिक: आस्तरणिक, अस्, आ, अम्, resting on a cloth or carpet.
आस्तार: आ-स्तार, अस्, m. spreading, strewing, scattering. —आस्तार-पङ्क्ति, इस्, f., N. of a metre, the first verse of which consists of two Pādas of eight syllables each, the second of two Pādas of twelve syllables each.
आस्तीर्ण: आ-स्तीर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, spread, strewed, scattered.
आस्तृत: आ-स्तृत, अस्, आ, अम्, spread, covered, strewed.
आस्त्रबुध्न: आस्त्रबुध्न आस्त्रबुध्न, अस्, m., Ved., N. of a man.
आस्था: आस्था 1. आ-स्था, cl. 1. P. or poet. A. -तिष्ठति, -ते, -स्थातुम्, to stand or remain on or by; to stay near, go towards, resort to; to ascend, mount; to undertake, perform, do, carry out, practise, use; to behave; to exhibit, aim at; to undertake, i. e. promise.

2. आ-स्था, f. consideration, regard, care, care for (with loc., e. g. मयि आस्था, care for me); assent, promise; confidence, hope; prop, stay, support; place or means of abiding; an assembly; state, con-dition.
आस्थातृ: आ-स्थातृ, ता, त्री, तृ, Ved. standing on, mount-ing on.
आस्थान: आ-स्थान, अम्, n. place, site, ground, base; an assembly; a hall of audience; (ई), f. an assembly. —आस्थान-गृह, अम्, n. an assembly-room.
आस्थापन: आ-स्थापन, अम्, n. placing, fixing, causing to stay or remain; a strengthening remedy; an enema of oil, ghee, &c.
आस्थापित: आ-स्थापित, अस्, आ, अम्, placed, fixed, &c.
आस्थाय: आ-स्थाय, ind. having recourse to, using, employ-ing; having ascended; standing, standing by.
आस्थायिका: आ-स्थायिका, f. audience; (e. g. आस्थायिकां दा, to give an audience.)
आस्थित: आ-स्थित, अस्, आ, अम्, stayed, dwelt, abiding, abode; having recourse to; applied to; occupied, engrossed by, engaged in; spread, overspread; obtained; ob-serving, adhering to, following, practising.
आस्थेय: आ-स्थेय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be approached, to be seized, to be applied or practised.
आस्नान: आस्नान आ-स्नान, अम्, n. (rt. स्ना), Ved. water for washing, a bath.
आस्नेय: आस्नेय आस्नेय, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. असन्), Ved. bloody, being in blood.
आस्पद: आस्पद आस्पद, अम्, n. (fr. पद with आ prefixed, स् being inserted), place, site, seat, office; rank, station; dignity, authority; business, affair. Often used in comp.; e. g. अहङ्कारास्पदम्, the seat of consciousness.
आस्पन्दन: आस्पन्दन आ-स्पन्दन, अम्, n. trembling, throbbing.
आस्पर्धा: आस्पर्धा आ-स्पर्धा, f. emulation, rivalry, endeavour after.
आस्पर्धिन्: आ-स्पर्धिन्, ई, इनी, इ, emulous, striving after.
आस्पर्श: आस्पर्श आ-स्पर्श, अस्, m. (rt. स्पृश्), contact; आस्पर्श-तस्, by the contact.
आस्फल्: आस्फल् आ-स्फल् or आ-स्फुल्, Caus. -स्फाल-यति, -यितुम्, to cause to flap, rock or shake.
आस्फाल: आ-स्फाल, अस्, m. striking, rubbing, causing to move gently; flapping, clapping; the flapping mo-tion of an elephant's ear.
आस्फालन: आ-स्फालन, अम्, n. rubbing, stirring, flapping, moving gently; striking; pride, arrogance.
आस्फालित: आ-स्फालित, अस्, आ, अम्, struck gently, rubbed, touched, stirred; flapped, clapped, struck together.
आस्फाय्: आस्फाय् आ-स्फाय्, cl. 1. A. -स्फायते, -यि-तुम्, to grow, increase.
आस्फुजित्: आस्फुजित् आस्फुजित् = Ἀφροδίτη N. of the planet Venus.
आस्फोट: आस्फोट आ-स्फोट, अस्, m. (rt. स्फुट्), moving or flapping to and fro, quivering, trembling, shaking, the sound of clapping or striking on the arms as made by combatants, wrestlers, &c.; a plant, see आ-स्फोत; (आ), f. a wild variety of Jasmin.
आस्फोटक: आ-स्फोटक, अस्, m., the plant Careya Arborea.
आस्फोटन: आ-स्फोटन, अम्, n. moving to and fro, flapping, trembling; shaking; blowing, expanding; contracting, closing, sealing; slapping or clapping the arms, or the noise made by it; (ई), f. a gimlet or auger.
आस्फोत: आ-स्फोत or आ-स्फोतक, अस्, m. (probably an in-correct form of आ-स्फोट), N. of several plants, Ca-lotropis Gigantea, Bahinia Variegata L., Echites Di-chotoma Roxb.; (आ), f., N. of several plants, Jasmi-num Sambac, Clitoria Terneata, Echites Frutescens or Echites Dichotoma.
आस्माक: आस्माक आस्माक, अस्, ई, अम्, or आस्माकीन, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. अस्माकम्), our, ours.
आस्य: आस्य आस्य, अम्, n. (see 3. आस्), mouth, jaws; face; a part of the mouth as the organ of pronouncing letters; mouth, opening; (अस्, आ, अम्), belonging or relating to the mouth or face. —आस्यन्-धय, अस्, ई, अम्, drinking the mouth, kissing. —आस्य-पत्त्र, अम्, n. a lotus. —आस्य-लाङ्गल, अस्, m. ‘whose face is a plough;’ a hog, a boar. —आस्य-लोमन्, अ, n. the hair of the face, the beard. —आस्यासव (°य-आस्°), अस्, m. spittle, saliva.
आस्यन्दन: आस्यन्दन आ-स्यन्दन, अम्, n. flowing near. —आस्यन्दन-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, flowing near.
आस्यहात्य: आस्यहात्य आस्यहात्य, अस्, आ, अम्, containing the word अस्यहत्य (a chapter).
आस्रप: आस्रप आस्रप, अस्, m. (fr. अस्र-प), the nineteenth lunar mansion.
आस्रव: आस्रव आ-स्रव, अस्, m. (fr. rt. स्रु with prep. आ), the foam on boiling rice; flowing, running, discharge; distress, pain, affliction; (with Jainas) that which directs the embodied spirit towards eternal objects, (viz. the occupation or employment of the senses or organs on sensible objects; or the association or connection of body with right and wrong deeds.)
आस्राव: आ-स्राव, अस्, m. flow, issue, running, discharge; pain, affliction; a disease of the body. —आस्राव-भेषज, अम्, n., Ved. a medicament, medicine.
आस्राविन्: आस्राविन्, ई, इणी, इ, flowing, emitting fluid, dis-charging humor; an epithet of the elephant (a fluid issuing from its temples during the rutting-time).
आस्रस्त: आस्रस्त आ-स्रस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, fallen off, loose.
आस्वद्: आस्वद् आ-स्वद् or -स्वाद्, cl. 1. A. -स्वदते or -स्वादते, -दितुम्, to taste, eat.
आस्वाद: आ-स्वाद, अस्, आ, अम्, tasting, eating; (अस्), m. tasting, enjoying, eating; flavour. —आस्वाद-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having a good taste, palatable; delicious in flavour.
आस्वादक: आ-स्वादक, अस्, इका, अम्, tasting, enjoying.
आस्वादन: आ-स्वादन, अम्, n. tasting, enjoying, eating.
आस्वादित: आ-स्वादित, अस्, आ, अम्, tasted, enjoyed, possessed; eaten.
आस्वाद्य: आ-स्वाद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be tasted or enjoyed, to be eaten; having a good taste, palatable, delicious. —आस्वाद्य-तोय, अस्, आ, अम्, having sweet or palata-ble water.
आस्वन्: आस्वन् आ-स्वन्, cl. 1. P. -स्वनति, -नितुम्, to sound.
आस्वनित: आ-स्वनित or आ-स्वान्त, अस्, आ, अम्, sounded.
आह: आह 1. आह, ind. (an interjection implying reproof, severity, command, casting, sending) Ah! Aha! &c.
आहक: आहक आहक, अस्, m. a peculiar disease of the nose, inflammation of the Schneiderian membrane.
आहङ्कार्य: आहङ्कार्य आहङ्कार्य, अम्, n. (fr. अहङ्-कार), conceitedness.
आहन्: आहन् आ-हन्, cl. 2. P. A. -हन्ति, -हते, -हन्तुम्, to strike at, hit, beat, kill; commit slaughter.
आहत: आ-हत, अस्, आ, अम्, struck, beaten; injured, killed; multiplied; known, understood; uttered falsely; (अस्), m. a drum; (अम्), n. old cloth or raiment; new cloth or clothes; assertion of an impossibility. —आहत-लक्षण, अस्, आ, अम्, noted for good qualities.
आहति: आ-हति, इस्, f. hitting, striking, a blow, a hit; killing.
आहनन: आ-हनन, अम्, n. the act of striking at, beating; killing of an animal.
आहनन्य: आहनन्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. making one's self known by beating (a drum &c.).
आहनस्: आहनस् आहनस्, आस्, आस्, अस् (fr. rt. हन् ?), Ved. swelling, tumid, crammed full; fat, luxuriant, lascivious; (Sāy.) to be beaten or pressed out (as Soma).
आहनस्य: आहनस्य, अम्, n., Ved. luxuriancy, lasciviousness; (आस्), f. pl. verses (ऋचस्) of a lascivious character. —आहनस्य-वादिन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. uttering las-civious words.
आहलक्: आहलक् आहलक्, ind., Ved. a smacking sound.
आहव: आहव, आहवन, आह्व, &c. See under आ-हु and आ-ह्वे।
1. आ-हव, अस्, m. sacrificing, sacrifice. (For 2. आ-हव see under आ-ह्वे।)
2. आ-हव, अस्, m. challenge, provoking, calling; war, battle. —आहव-काम्या, f. desire of war: (for 1. आ-हव see under आ-हु, page 136, col. 3.)
आहिक: आहिक आहिक, अस्, m. (fr. अहि), the descend-ing node; an epithet of the grammarian Pāṇini.
आहिकम्: आहिकम् आहिकम्, a particle = आहि कम् (?).
आहिण्ड्: आहिण्ड् आ-हिण्ड्, cl. 1. A. -हिण्डते, -डितुम्, to roam about.
आहिण्डिक: आहिण्डिक आहिण्डिक, अस्, m. a man of mixed origin, the son of a Niṣāda father and a Vaidehī mother, employed as a watchman on the outside of gaols &c.
आहित: आहित आ-हित, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. धा with prep. आ), placed, deposited; entertained, felt; com-prising, containing; performed, done. —आहित-क्लम, अस्, आ, अम्, exhausted. —आहित-लक्षण, अस्, आ, अम्, noted or known for good qualities; [cf. आहत-लक्षण।] —आहित-व्यथ, अस्, आ, अम्, pained, grieved. —आहित-स्वन, अस्, आ, अम्, uttering or making a sound noisy. —आहिताग्नि (°त-अग्°), इस्, इस्, इ, one who has placed the sacred fire upon the altar, a sacrificer; a Brāhman who has kept alive a sacred fire perpetually in a family &c. —आहिताङ्क (°त-अङ्°), अस्, आ, अम्, marked, spotted, stained.
आहिति: आ-हिति, इस्, f., Ved. placing on; anything placed on.
आहितुण्डिक: आहितुण्डिक आहितुण्डिक or अहितुण्डिक, अस्, m. (fr. अहि-तुण्ड), a snake-catcher, a juggler.
आहीरणिन्: आहीरणिन् आहीरणिन्, ई, m. a two-headed snake.
आहु: आहु आ-हु, cl. 3. P. A. -जुहोते, -जुहुते, -हो-तुम्, to sacrifice, to offer an oblation, to worship.
आहवन: आ-हवन, अम्, n., Ved. offering an oblation, offering sacrifice, sacrifice.
आहवनीय: आ-हवनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be offered as an obla-tion; (अस्), m. a consecrated fire taken from the householder's perpetual fire and prepared for receiving oblations; the eastern of the three fires burning at a sacrifice.
आहवनीयक: आहवनीयक, अस्, आ, अम्, fit for a burnt offering; (अस्), m. a consecrated fire.
आहाव: 1. आ-हाव, अस्, m., Ved. a trough, a pail, a vessel; a trough near a well for watering cattle.
2. आ-हाव, अस्, m. calling, invoking; battle, war.
आहुत: आ-हुत, अम्, n. an offering made to men, hospi-tality; the nourishment of all created beings con-sidered as one of the five sacraments or principal sacrifices of the Hindūs.
आहुति: 1. आ-हुति, इस्, f. offering oblations with fire to the deities; any solemn rite accompanied with oblations: (for 2. आ-हुति see under आ-ह्वे।) —आहुती-वृध्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. delighting in sacrifices.
2. आ-हुति, calling, invoking. (This word may sometimes have this sense in the oldest Vedic texts, but see the more correct form आ-हूति। For 1. आ-हुति see under आ-हु last col.)
आहुक: आहुक आहुक, अस्, m., N. of a prince, great-grandfather of Kṛṣṇa, a son or grandson of Abhi-jit; (ई), f. a sister of this prince; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a people.
आहुल्य: आहुल्य आहुल्य, अम्, n., N. of the legumi-nous shrub Tabernæmontana Coronaria.
आहृ: आहृ आ-हृ, cl. 1. P. A. -हरति, -ते, -हर्तुम्, to fetch, bring, bring near, give; to recover, bring back; to get, take; to offer in sacrifice: Caus. P. -हारयति, -यितुम्, to make one pay or give or fetch or bring; to exact; to exert, exhibit: Desid. A. -जिहीर्षते, to seek to recover or get back.
आहर: आ-हर, अस्, आ, अम्, (at the end of compounds) bringing, fetching; (अस्), m. taking, seizing; accom-plishing, offering of a sacrifice; drawing in breath, inhaling, inhaled air; breath inspired, inspiration.
आहरण: आ-हरण, अस्, आ, अम्, taking away, robbing; (अम्), n. taking, seizing, bringing near; extracting, remov-ing; accomplishing, offering at a sacrifice; causing, inducing.
आहरणीकृ: आहरणी-कृ, cl. 8. P. -करोति, -कर्तुम्, to give as a present.
आहर्तृ: आ-हर्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who takes, seizes, brings or procures; inducing, causing; offering; (ता), m. a copy holder (in law).
आहार: आ-हार, अस्, आ, or ई, अम्, bringing near, procuring; going to fetch; (अस्), m. taking, fetching, bringing near; employing; taking food, food (e. g. आहारं कृ, to take food, eat). —आहार-विरह, अस्, m. want of food. —आहार-सम्भव, अस्, m. the juice of the body, chyle, lymph, serum. —आहारार्थिन् (°र-अर्°), ई, इनी, इ, begging or seeking for food.
आहारक: आ-हारक, अस्, आ, अम्, going to fetch.
आहारिक: आ-हारिक, (with Jainas) one of the five bodies belonging to the soul; described by Colebrooke as a minute form, issuing from the head of a meditative sage to consult an omniscient saint and returning with the desired information.
आहार्य: आ-हार्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be taken or seized; to be fetched or brought near; to be extracted or removed; what may be removed, adventitious, accessary, inci-dental; to be eaten; (अस्), m. a kind of bandage; (अम्), n. any disease to be treated by the operation of extracting; extraction; a vessel; the ornamentative part of the drama, the dress, decorations, &c. —आहार्य-शोभा, f. adventitious beauty, beauty not natural but the effect of paints, ornaments, &c.
आहृत: आ-हृत, अस्, आ, अम्, brought, taken, collected. —आहृत-यज्ञ-क्रतु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. intending (to offer) a prepared sacrifice; preparing a sacrificial act (?).
आहृत्य: आ-हृत्य, ind. having taken or received, having brought.
आहेय: आहेय आहेय, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अहि), belonging or relating to a snake.
आहो: आहो आहो, ind. (an interjection of doubt and of asking) or, or perhaps. —आहो-पुरुषिका, f. great self-conceit, boasting, military vaunting; a vain determination to accomplish an object, vaunting of one's power. —आहो-स्वित्, ind. a particle implying doubt.
आह्न: आह्न आह्न, अस्, अम्, m. n. (fr. अहन्), a series of days, many days.
आह्निक: आह्निक, अस्, ई, अम्, daily, diurnal, performed on a day, performed every day; (अम्), n. a religious cere-mony to be performed every day at a fixed hour; a day's work, what may be read on one day, the division or section of a book; constant occupation, daily work; daily food, &c. —आह्निकाचार (°क-आच्°), अस्, m. daily observance, the prayers and practices necessary for bodily and mental purification.
आह्नेय: आह्नेय, अस्, m. a patronymic of Śauca.
आह्लाद्: आह्लाद् आ-ह्लाद्, Caus. P. -ह्लादयति, -यितुम्, to gladden.
आह्लाद: आ-ह्लाद, अस्, m. joy, delight. —आह्लाद-दुघ, अस्, आ, अम्, conferring delight.
आह्लादि: आ-ह्लादि, इस्, m., N. of a son of Babhru.
आह्लादित: आ-ह्लादित, अस्, आ, अम्, delighted, rejoiced.
आह्वृ: आह्वृ आ-ह्वृ, cl. 1. P., Ved. -ह्वरति, -ह्वर्-तुम्, to make crooked, to injure.
आहूर्य: आ-हूर्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. to be bent down or brought near; to be made favourable, one towards whom one must bow; (Sāy.) to be invoked (fr. rt. ह्वे).
आह्रुत: आ-ह्रुत, अस्, आ, अम्, injured. —आह्रुत-भेषज, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. curing what is bent or injured.
आह्वर: आ-ह्वर, अस्, m., N. of a fortress of the Uśīnaras.
आह्वरक: आ-ह्वरक, अस्, m. a low or expelled man who, after having offered a sacrifice to the manes, takes the sacrificial food for himself.
आह्वारक: आह्वारक, आस्, m. pl. the Āhvārakas, a recension of the black Yajur-veda (distinct from the Taittirīya) named from Ahvāra or Āhvāra.
आह्वृति: आ-ह्वृति, इस्, m., N. of a prince.
आह्वे: आह्वे आ-ह्वे, cl. 1. P. or poet. A. -ह्वयति, -ते, -ह्वातुम्, to call near; to summon; to invite, ask; A. to provoke, challenge, emulate: Caus. -ह्वाययति, -यितुम्, to send for; to cause to invite or summon or challenge; provoked: Desid. -जुहू-षति, to wish to call near or invite: Intens. -जोहवीति, to call.
आहुव: आ-हुव, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. (Sāy.) to be invoked.
आहूत: 2. आ-हूत, अस्, आ, अम्, called, summoned, invoked, invited. —आहूत-प्रपलायिन्, ई, m. a defendant or witness absconding or not appearing when summoned.
आह्व: आ-ह्व, अस्, आ, अम्, who or what calls, a crier; named, called; (आ), f. a name, appellation.
आह्वय: आ-ह्वय, अस्, m. a lawsuit arising from a dispute about games with animals, as cock-fighting &c.; ap-pellation, name (generally as last member of a com-pound, the first member of which, though commonly an appellative noun, is used as a proper name).
आह्वयत्: आ-ह्वयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, calling, challenging.
आह्वयितव्य: आ-ह्वयितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be summoned or invited.
आह्वान: आ-ह्वान, अम्, n. calling, invitation, a call or sum-mons; invocation of a deity; challenge; legal sum-mons; an appellation, a name; designation of a liturgical formula. —आह्वान-दर्शन, अम्, n. day of trial.
आह्वानय: आह्वानय, nom. P. आह्वानयति, -यितुम्, (in law) to summon.
आह्वाय: आ-ह्वाय, अस्, m. a summons, a name.
आह्वायक: आ-ह्वायक, अस्, m. a messenger, a courier.
आह्वाययितव्य: आ-ह्वाययितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be called before a tribunal.
आकेकर: आ-केकर, अस्, ई, अम्, slightly looking askance.
आङ्गारिक: आङ्गारिक, अस्, m. one having to do with charcoal, a charcoal-burner.
आत्मसन्तान: आत्म-सन्तान, अस्, m. ‘own offspring,’ a son.
आदीपक: आ-दीपक, अस्, m. one who sets fire to anything, an incendiary.
आपरपक्षीय: आपरपक्षीय (fr. अपर-पक्ष), belonging or relating to the second half of a month.
आप्तोर्याम: आप्तोर्-याम, अस्, m. = अप्तोर्-याम, q. v.
आप्सरस: आप्सरस, अस्, ई, अम्, coming from an Apsaras.
आफलक: आ-फलक, a fence made of planks, palisade.
आब्दम्: आब्दम् (आ-अब्°), ind. for a whole year.
आभरित: आ-भरित, अस्, आ, अम्, ornamented, adorned.
आमिषता: आमिष-ता, f. the being a prey.
आरोध: आ-रोध, अस्, m. a siege, blockade.
आर्जविन्: आर्जविन्, ई, इनी, इ (fr. आर्जव), having honesty, upright, honest, straightforward.
आवर्जन: आ-वर्जन, अम्, n. victory, conquest (= जय).
आविर्मण्डल: आविर्-मण्डल, अस्, आ, अम्, manifesting the form of a circle.
आवेध: आ-वेध, अस्, m. (fr. आ-व्यध्), shaking about.
आशिष्ठ: आशिष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम् (superl. of आशु), quickest.
आशीयस्: आशीयस्, आन्, असी, अस् (compar. of आशु), quicker.
आष्टमिक: आष्टमिक, अस्, ई, अम्, taught in the eighth book (of Pāṇini).
आसंसृतेः: आ-संसृतेः, ind. till the end of the world, as long as the course of this world lasts.
आसिधार: आसिधार, अम्, n. (fr. असि-धारा), scil. व्रतम्, a vow as difficult as standing on the edge of a sword.
आहङ्कारिक: आहङ्कारिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अहङ्-कार), belong-ing or relating to Ahaṅkāra.
